# Cairn UI 0.2.0

Cairn UI is a Flutter component library: 65 component modules on one design-token layer (OKLCH colour, a multiplier-based radius scale, a Tailwind spacing scale, a type scale), light and dark themes, and golden tests.

## Install

```yaml
dependencies:
  cairn_ui: ^0.2.0
```

```dart
import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';
```

## Conventions

- Import the whole library with one line: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`. There are no per-component imports.
- Every public widget is prefixed `Cairn` (`CairnButton`, `CairnCard`). Do not invent widgets that are not listed by `list_components`.
- Colours, radii, spacing and type come from the theme, never literals: `CairnTheme.of(context).primary`, `theme.radiusScale.md`, `CairnSpacing.s4`, `theme.textStyle(CairnTypography.sm)`.
- Read the theme with `CairnTheme.of(context)`. Install it with `ThemeData(extensions: [CairnTheme.light])` or `CairnTheme.materialTheme(CairnTheme.light)`.
- Icon-only buttons use `CairnButton.icon(...)` and need a `semanticLabel`.
- Prefer a Cairn component over a Material one when both exist; Cairn has no ripple, so interactions are colour and shadow transitions.
- `CairnTone` (neutral, primary, success, warning, info, destructive) colours state-bearing components such as Status, Steps, Timeline and Radial Progress.
- Components that open overlays (toasts, dialogs, sheets) need a Navigator or a `CairnToaster` above them.

## What is available

- **Forms**: Button, Input, Textarea, Label, Checkbox, Switch, Radio Group, Slider, Toggle, Toggle Group, Input OTP, Form Field, Rating, Swap, File Input, Floating Action Button
- **Display**: Card, Badge, Avatar, Alert, Separator, Skeleton, Spinner, Kbd, Aspect Ratio, Empty, Table, Stat, Status, Timeline, Chat Bubble, Indicator, Stack, Hero, Diff, List, Mockup
- **Overlays**: Dialog, Alert Dialog, Sheet, Drawer, Popover, Tooltip, Hover Card, Dropdown Menu, Context Menu, Menu, Select, Combobox, Command
- **Navigation**: Tabs, Accordion, Collapsible, Breadcrumb, Pagination, Menubar, Navigation Menu, Scroll Area, Carousel, Steps, Navbar, Dock, Link
- **Data & feedback**: Progress, Toast, Data Table, Calendar, Date Picker, Radial Progress, Countdown

5 blocks (Login, Dashboard shell, Settings, Pricing, Team roster) and 5 whole-app templates (E-commerce, Dashboard, Blog, Documentation, SaaS landing).

## How to use this server

1. `search_components` with the user's need in plain words, or `list_components` to browse.
2. `get_component` for the exact constructor, parameters, enums and copy-pasteable examples. Do not guess parameter names.
3. `get_tokens` / `get_theme` before writing any colour, spacing or theme code.
4. `get_block` or `get_template` when the user wants a whole screen or app.
5. `get_docs` for installation, theming, accessibility and architecture guides.


---

# Button

Six variants across eight sizes, with icon and loading forms.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnButton`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Heights are h-6 / h-8 / h-9 / h-10 — 24, 32, 36 and 40 logical pixels. The outline variant gains a dark:bg-input/30 fill that has no light-mode counterpart.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnButton(
  variant: CairnButtonVariant.outline,
  size: CairnButtonSize.md,
  onPressed: () => _deploy(),
  child: const Text('Deploy'),
)

CairnButton.icon(
  icon: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.check),
  semanticLabel: 'Confirm',
  onPressed: _confirm,
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Primary

```dart
CairnButton(
  onPressed: () {},
  child: const Text('Primary'),
)
```

### Secondary

```dart
CairnButton(
  variant: CairnButtonVariant.secondary,
  onPressed: () {},
  child: const Text('Secondary'),
)
```

### Destructive

```dart
CairnButton(
  variant: CairnButtonVariant.destructive,
  onPressed: () {},
  child: const Text('Destructive'),
)
```

### Outline

```dart
CairnButton(
  variant: CairnButtonVariant.outline,
  onPressed: () {},
  child: const Text('Outline'),
)
```

### Ghost

```dart
CairnButton(
  variant: CairnButtonVariant.ghost,
  onPressed: () {},
  child: const Text('Ghost'),
)
```

### Link

```dart
CairnButton(
  variant: CairnButtonVariant.link,
  onPressed: () {},
  child: const Text('Link'),
)
```

### Icon only

```dart
CairnButton.icon(
  icon: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.check),
  semanticLabel: 'Confirm',
  variant: CairnButtonVariant.outline,
  onPressed: () {},
)
```

### Loading

```dart
CairnButton(
  onPressed: () {},
  leading: const CairnSpinner(),
  child: const Text('Saving'),
)
```

### Disabled

```dart
const CairnButton(
  onPressed: null,
  child: Text('Disabled'),
)
```

### Size · xs

```dart
CairnButton(
  size: CairnButtonSize.xs,
  onPressed: () {},
  child: const Text('Extra small'),
)
```

### Size · sm

```dart
CairnButton(
  variant: CairnButtonVariant.destructive,
  size: CairnButtonSize.sm,
  onPressed: () {},
  child: const Text('Small'),
)
```

### Size · md

```dart
CairnButton(
  size: CairnButtonSize.md,
  onPressed: () {},
  child: const Text('Medium'),
)
```

### Size · lg

```dart
CairnButton(
  size: CairnButtonSize.lg,
  onPressed: () {},
  child: const Text('Large'),
)
```

## API

### `CairnButton` (widget)

A button with six variants and eight sizes.

The default size is 36 logical pixels tall with 16px of horizontal padding
(`h-9 px-4`), and its label is 14px at weight 500 (`text-sm font-medium`) —
a scale that keeps a row of buttons in line with 14px body text. Variants
are [CairnButtonVariant], sizes [CairnButtonSize].

```dart
CairnButton(
  onPressed: () => print('tapped'),
  child: const Text('Continue'),
);

CairnButton(
  variant: CairnButtonVariant.outline,
  size: CairnButtonSize.sm,
  leading: const Icon(Icons.add),
  onPressed: () {},
  child: const Text('Add item'),
);
```

## Accessibility

The button is a focusable [Semantics] button, activates on both Space and
Enter, and shows its focus ring only on keyboard focus — see
[CairnInteractive] for how `:focus-visible` is reproduced. Passing null to
[onPressed] disables it, which removes it from focus traversal and drops its
opacity to 50%.

**Constructor** `CairnButton({required Widget child, VoidCallback? onPressed, VoidCallback? onLongPress, CairnButtonVariant variant = CairnButtonVariant.primary, CairnButtonSize size = CairnButtonSize.md, Widget? leading, Widget? trailing, FocusNode? focusNode, bool autofocus = false, String? semanticLabel, bool expand = false})`

Creates a button.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | The button's label, or its icon when built with [CairnButton.icon]. |
| `onPressed` | `VoidCallback?` |  |  | Called when the button is activated. Null disables the button. |
| `onLongPress` | `VoidCallback?` |  |  | Called on long press. |
| `variant` | `CairnButtonVariant` |  | `CairnButtonVariant.primary` | The visual style. |
| `size` | `CairnButtonSize` |  | `CairnButtonSize.md` | The size. |
| `leading` | `Widget?` |  |  | An icon placed before [child], separated by the size's `gap`. |
| `trailing` | `Widget?` |  |  | An icon placed after [child], separated by the size's `gap`. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` |  |  | An externally supplied focus node. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to take focus on first build. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. Required for [CairnButton.icon]. |
| `expand` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to stretch to the available width. Cairn exposes this as an explicit flag rather than folding it into [CairnButtonSize], since width is orthogonal to height and padding: any of the eight sizes can stretch, and none of them implies it. |

**Constructor** `CairnButton.icon({required Widget icon, required String semanticLabel, VoidCallback? onPressed, VoidCallback? onLongPress, CairnButtonVariant variant = CairnButtonVariant.primary, CairnButtonSize size = CairnButtonSize.iconMd, FocusNode? focusNode, bool autofocus = false})`

Creates an icon-only button.

Uses a square size and applies [semanticLabel] as the accessible name.
The label is a required parameter, not an optional one: an icon-only
button has no visible text for a screen reader to fall back on, and
making it required is the only reliable way to stop that being
forgotten.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `Widget` | yes |  |  |
| `semanticLabel` | `String` | yes |  | The accessible name. Required for [CairnButton.icon]. |
| `onPressed` | `VoidCallback?` |  |  | Called when the button is activated. Null disables the button. |
| `onLongPress` | `VoidCallback?` |  |  | Called on long press. |
| `variant` | `CairnButtonVariant` |  | `CairnButtonVariant.primary` | The visual style. |
| `size` | `CairnButtonSize` |  | `CairnButtonSize.iconMd` | The size. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` |  |  | An externally supplied focus node. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to take focus on first build. |

### `CairnButtonVariant` (enum)

The visual style of a [CairnButton].

Six deliberate variants, each mapped to a semantic slot in [CairnTheme]
rather than to a fixed colour — so retheming moves all of them together, and
the choice between them stays a statement about emphasis rather than about
paint.

- `CairnButtonVariant.primary` — `bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90`.
- `CairnButtonVariant.destructive` — `bg-destructive text-white hover:bg-destructive/90`. The dark theme softens the fill to 60% (`dark:bg-destructive/60`): full-strength red against a dark page reads as an alarm rather than as a button.
- `CairnButtonVariant.outline` — `border bg-background shadow-xs hover:bg-accent`. The dark theme adds a translucent fill (`dark:bg-input/30`) that has no light-mode counterpart.
- `CairnButtonVariant.secondary` — `bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80`.
- `CairnButtonVariant.ghost` — `hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground`, no fill at rest.
- `CairnButtonVariant.link` — `text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline`.

### `CairnButtonSize` (enum)

The size of a [CairnButton].

Four sizes for buttons with a label and four square sizes for icon-only
ones. The icon sizes are separate entries rather than a flag on the others,
because a square button is not simply a text button with the label removed
— it drops horizontal padding entirely and takes its width from its
height.

- `CairnButtonSize.xs` — `h-6 gap-1 px-2 text-xs` with 12px icons.
- `CairnButtonSize.sm` — `h-8 gap-1.5 px-3`.
- `CairnButtonSize.md` — `h-9 px-4 py-2` — the default.
- `CairnButtonSize.lg` — `h-10 px-6`.
- `CairnButtonSize.iconXs` — `size-6` — square, icon only.
- `CairnButtonSize.iconSm` — `size-8` — square, icon only.
- `CairnButtonSize.iconMd` — `size-9` — square, icon only.
- `CairnButtonSize.iconLg` — `size-10` — square, icon only.


---

# Input

A single-line text field with leading and trailing slots.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnInput`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> h-9, px-3, rounded-md, bg-transparent with a shadow-xs resting elevation. Focus adds a 3px ring at 50% alpha.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnInput(
  controller: _email,
  placeholder: 'name@example.com',
  keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
  hasError: _error != null,
  onChanged: _validate,
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Default

```dart
const CairnInput(placeholder: 'name@example.com')
```

### Error

```dart
const CairnInput(
  placeholder: 'Invalid',
  hasError: true,
)
```

### Disabled

```dart
const CairnInput(
  placeholder: 'Disabled',
  enabled: false,
)
```

## API

### `CairnInput` (widget)

A single-line text field.

36 logical pixels tall (`h-9`) with 12px of horizontal padding, an 8px
radius, a 1px outline in the input token and the smallest shadow in the
scale — the same height as the default Button, so the two sit level in a
form row. Focus swaps the border to the ring colour and adds a 3px outset at
50% alpha. The dark theme adds a translucent fill that light mode does not
have, since a hairline alone barely separates a field from a dark page.

## Implementation note

This wraps Flutter's [TextField] with [InputDecoration.collapsed] rather
than rebuilding text editing on [EditableText]. Text input is deceptively
deep — selection handles, the context menu, autofill, IME composition,
spell check and platform-specific caret behaviour — and reimplementing it
would mean losing all of it. Cairn replaces only the *chrome*: the Material
border, fill and floating label are stripped, and the visual shell is drawn
by this widget instead.

```dart
CairnInput(
  controller: controller,
  placeholder: 'name@example.com',
  keyboardType: TextInputType.emailAddress,
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnInput({TextEditingController? controller, FocusNode? focusNode, String? placeholder, bool enabled = true, bool readOnly = false, bool obscureText = false, bool autofocus = false, bool hasError = false, TextInputType? keyboardType, TextInputAction? textInputAction, List<TextInputFormatter>? inputFormatters, int? maxLength, ValueChanged<String>? onChanged, ValueChanged<String>? onSubmitted, Widget? leading, Widget? trailing, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a text input.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | `TextEditingController?` |  |  | Controls the text being edited. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` |  |  | An externally supplied focus node. |
| `placeholder` | `String?` |  |  | Text shown when the field is empty (`placeholder:text-muted-foreground`). |
| `enabled` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether the field accepts input. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether the field is read-only. |
| `obscureText` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to hide the text, for passwords. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to take focus on first build. |
| `hasError` | `bool` |  | `false` | Marks the field invalid (`aria-invalid`), switching the border and ring to the destructive token. |
| `keyboardType` | `TextInputType?` |  |  | The keyboard type. |
| `textInputAction` | `TextInputAction?` |  |  | The keyboard action button. |
| `inputFormatters` | `List<TextInputFormatter>?` |  |  | Input formatters applied as the user types. |
| `maxLength` | `int?` |  |  | The maximum number of characters. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<String>?` |  |  | Called whenever the text changes. |
| `onSubmitted` | `ValueChanged<String>?` |  |  | Called when the user submits. |
| `leading` | `Widget?` |  |  | A widget before the text, such as a search icon. |
| `trailing` | `Widget?` |  |  | A widget after the text. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. |

# Textarea

A multi-line field that grows with its content.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnTextarea`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Auto-growing by default, matching CSS field-sizing: content, which Flutter has no direct equivalent for.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnTextarea(
  controller: _bio,
  placeholder: 'Tell us a little about yourself...',
  minLines: 3,
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Default

```dart
const CairnTextarea(
  placeholder: 'Tell us a little about yourself...',
)
```

### Error

```dart
const CairnTextarea(
  placeholder: 'Say a little more than that',
  hasError: true,
)
```

## API

### `CairnTextarea` (widget)

A multi-line text field.

`min-h-16 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-2
text-sm shadow-xs` — a 64 logical pixel minimum height with 12px horizontal
and 8px vertical padding.

The box grows with its content rather than making the user scroll inside a
fixed frame — the web spells that `field-sizing-content`; in Flutter it is
[TextField] with a null `maxLines`, which is what [autoGrow] enables.

```dart
CairnTextarea(
  controller: controller,
  placeholder: 'Tell us what happened...',
  minLines: 3,
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnTextarea({TextEditingController? controller, FocusNode? focusNode, String? placeholder, bool enabled = true, bool readOnly = false, bool autofocus = false, bool hasError = false, bool autoGrow = true, int? minLines, int? maxLines, int? maxLength, List<TextInputFormatter>? inputFormatters, ValueChanged<String>? onChanged, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a multi-line text field.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `controller` | `TextEditingController?` |  |  | Controls the text being edited. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` |  |  | An externally supplied focus node. |
| `placeholder` | `String?` |  |  | Text shown when empty. |
| `enabled` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether the field accepts input. |
| `readOnly` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether the field is read-only. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to take focus on first build. |
| `hasError` | `bool` |  | `false` | Marks the field invalid, switching the border and ring to destructive. |
| `autoGrow` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether the box grows with its content (`field-sizing-content`). |
| `minLines` | `int?` |  |  | The minimum number of visible lines. |
| `maxLines` | `int?` |  |  | The maximum number of visible lines before scrolling. Ignored when [autoGrow] is true. |
| `maxLength` | `int?` |  |  | The maximum number of characters. |
| `inputFormatters` | `List<TextInputFormatter>?` |  |  | Input formatters applied as the user types. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<String>?` |  |  | Called whenever the text changes. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. |

# Label

A form label with leading-none and a disabled treatment.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnLabel`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> line-height: 1 has to be set explicitly — Flutter defaults to the font metrics (~1.2), which makes labels sit low.

## Quick start

```dart
const CairnLabel('Accept terms and conditions')

CairnLabel.custom(
  child: Row(children: const <Widget>[Text('Email'), Text('*')]),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Default

```dart
const CairnLabel('Accept terms and conditions')
```

### Disabled

```dart
const CairnLabel('Disabled field', enabled: false)
```

## API

### `CairnLabel` (widget)

A form label.

`flex items-center gap-2 text-sm leading-none font-medium select-none`.

Note `leading-none`: the label's line height is exactly 1.0, not the font's
natural metric. Flutter's default line height comes from font metrics
(~1.2), so this must be set explicitly or a label sits a pixel or two low
relative to the control it labels.

Setting [enabled] to false drops the label to 50% opacity, so a disabled
control and its label read as one inert unit rather than a live label above
a dead field.

```dart
Column(
  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
  spacing: 8,
  children: [
    const CairnLabel('Email'),
    CairnInput(controller: controller),
  ],
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnLabel(String? text, {bool enabled = true})`

Creates a label from a string.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `String?` | yes |  | The label text, when built with the default constructor. |
| `enabled` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether the labelled control is enabled. False dims the label to 50%. |

**Constructor** `CairnLabel.custom({required Widget child, bool enabled = true})`

Creates a label wrapping arbitrary content, such as text plus a badge.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | A custom label body, when built with [CairnLabel.custom]. |
| `enabled` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether the labelled control is enabled. False dims the label to 50%. |


---

# Checkbox

A checkbox with optional indeterminate state.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnCheckbox`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> The radius is a literal rounded-[4px], not a step on the --radius scale.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnCheckbox(
  value: _accepted,
  tristate: true,
  onChanged: (bool? v) => setState(() => _accepted = v),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Checked

```dart
bool? _accepted = true;

Row(
  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
  spacing: CairnSpacing.s2,
  children: <Widget>[
    CairnCheckbox(
      value: _accepted,
      onChanged: (bool? v) => setState(() => _accepted = v),
    ),
    const CairnLabel('Accept terms and conditions'),
  ],
)
```

### Indeterminate

```dart
bool? _mixed;

Row(
  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
  spacing: CairnSpacing.s2,
  children: <Widget>[
    CairnCheckbox(
      value: _mixed,
      tristate: true,
      onChanged: (bool? v) => setState(() => _mixed = v),
    ),
    const CairnLabel('Tristate (click through null)'),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnCheckbox` (widget)

A checkbox, optionally with an indeterminate third state.

`size-4 shrink-0 rounded-[4px] border border-input shadow-xs` — 16 logical
pixels square with a 4px radius. That radius is a **literal 4px**, not a
step on the radius scale, so it holds even when a theme retunes its base: at
16px square, a proportionally scaled radius would round the box into a
blob.

Checking swaps to `bg-primary border-primary text-primary-foreground` and
draws a 14px (`size-3.5`) check.

Supports a tristate (indeterminate) value, rendered as a minus instead of a
check — the state a "select all" box needs when only some of the boxes it
governs are ticked.

```dart
CairnCheckbox(
  value: accepted,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => accepted = v ?? false),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnCheckbox({required bool? value, ValueChanged<bool?>? onChanged, bool tristate = false, bool hasError = false, FocusNode? focusNode, bool autofocus = false, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a checkbox.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `bool?` | yes |  | Whether the box is checked. Null means indeterminate when [tristate] is true. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<bool?>?` |  |  | Called with the next value when the user toggles the box. Null disables the checkbox. |
| `tristate` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether the box cycles through an indeterminate state. |
| `hasError` | `bool` |  | `false` | Marks the control invalid (`aria-invalid`). |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` |  |  | An externally supplied focus node. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to take focus on first build. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. |


---

# Switch

A binary toggle with an animated thumb.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnSwitch`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> The track is h-[1.15rem] w-8 — literally 18.4 x 32 logical pixels. Rounding that to 18 or 20 is exactly the drift Cairn exists to avoid.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnSwitch(
  value: _notifications,
  semanticLabel: 'Email notifications',
  onChanged: (bool v) => setState(() => _notifications = v),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Default

```dart
bool _notifications = true;

Row(
  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
  spacing: CairnSpacing.s3,
  children: <Widget>[
    CairnSwitch(
      value: _notifications,
      semanticLabel: 'Notifications',
      onChanged: (bool v) => setState(() => _notifications = v),
    ),
    const CairnLabel('Email notifications'),
  ],
)
```

### Small

```dart
bool _compact = false;

Row(
  mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
  spacing: CairnSpacing.s3,
  children: <Widget>[
    CairnSwitch(
      value: _compact,
      size: CairnSwitchSize.sm,
      semanticLabel: 'Compact mode',
      onChanged: (bool v) => setState(() => _compact = v),
    ),
    const CairnLabel('Compact mode'),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnSwitch` (widget)

A switch.

The default track is `h-[1.15rem] w-8` — **18.4 logical pixels** tall, not
a round number, and deliberately so. The height is derived rather than
chosen: a 16px thumb has to clear the 1px transparent border on both sides
with a hair of room, and 18.4 is where that lands. Rounding it to 18 pinches
the thumb; rounding it to 20 leaves it swimming.

The thumb travels `translate-x-[calc(100%-2px)]` when checked — its own
width minus 2px, so 14 logical pixels at the default size.

The dark theme inverts the thumb: unchecked it is `bg-foreground`, checked
it is `bg-primary-foreground`, whereas light mode keeps it `bg-background`
throughout.

```dart
CairnSwitch(
  value: notifications,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => notifications = v),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnSwitch({required bool value, ValueChanged<bool>? onChanged, CairnSwitchSize size = CairnSwitchSize.md, FocusNode? focusNode, bool autofocus = false, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a switch.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `bool` | yes |  | Whether the switch is on. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` |  |  | Called with the next value. Null disables the switch. |
| `size` | `CairnSwitchSize` |  | `CairnSwitchSize.md` | The size. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` |  |  | An externally supplied focus node. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to take focus on first build. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. |

### `CairnSwitchSize` (enum)

The size of a [CairnSwitch].

- `CairnSwitchSize.sm` — `h-3.5 w-6` with a `size-3` thumb — 14 x 24 with a 12px thumb.
- `CairnSwitchSize.md` — `h-[1.15rem] w-8` with a `size-4` thumb — 18.4 x 32 with a 16px thumb.


---

# Radio Group

Mutually exclusive options with roving focus.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnRadioGroup`, `CairnRadioItem`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> One tab stop for the whole group; arrow keys move the selection within it, as the ARIA radio-group pattern requires.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnRadioGroup<String>(
  value: _plan,
  onChanged: (String v) => setState(() => _plan = v),
  children: const <Widget>[
    CairnRadioItem<String>(value: 'free', label: Text('Free')),
    CairnRadioItem<String>(value: 'pro', label: Text('Pro')),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Plan picker

```dart
String _plan = 'pro';

CairnRadioGroup<String>(
  value: _plan,
  onChanged: (String v) => setState(() => _plan = v),
  children: const <Widget>[
    CairnRadioItem<String>(value: 'free', label: Text('Free')),
    CairnRadioItem<String>(value: 'pro', label: Text('Pro')),
    CairnRadioItem<String>(
      value: 'team',
      label: Text('Team (unavailable)'),
      enabled: false,
    ),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnRadioGroup` (widget)

A group of mutually exclusive radio buttons.

The group itself is `grid gap-3` — a 12 logical pixel gap between items.

## Accessibility

The group uses **roving focus**: it holds a single tab stop, and arrow keys
move the selection within it. Cairn implements that with a
[FocusTraversalGroup] plus arrow-key [Shortcuts], so tabbing lands on the
group once instead of stepping through every option — which is both the
accessible behaviour and what makes a ten-option group survivable from the
keyboard.

```dart
CairnRadioGroup<String>(
  value: plan,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => plan = v),
  children: const [
    CairnRadioItem(value: 'free', label: Text('Free')),
    CairnRadioItem(value: 'pro', label: Text('Pro')),
  ],
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnRadioGroup({required T? value, required List<Widget> children, ValueChanged<T>? onChanged, double spacing = CairnSpacing.s3, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a radio group.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `T?` | yes |  | The currently selected value. |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | yes |  | The items in this group. Typically [CairnRadioItem]s. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<T>?` |  |  | Called when the selection changes. Null disables the whole group. |
| `spacing` | `double` |  | `CairnSpacing.s3` | The gap between items (`gap-3`). |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name for the group. |

### `CairnRadioItem` (widget)

One option inside a [CairnRadioGroup].

The control is `aspect-square size-4 rounded-full border border-input
shadow-xs` with a `size-2 fill-primary` dot when selected — a 16px circle
containing an 8px filled dot.

**Constructor** `CairnRadioItem({required T value, Widget? label, bool enabled = true, FocusNode? focusNode, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a radio item.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `T` | yes |  | The value this item selects. |
| `label` | `Widget?` |  |  | An optional label rendered beside the control. |
| `enabled` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether this individual item is selectable. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` |  |  | An externally supplied focus node. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. Falls back to [label] when that is a [Text]. |


---

# Slider

A range control driven by pointer or keyboard.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnSlider`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> The thumb is a literal bg-white in both themes, and the focus halo is ring-4 rather than the usual 3px.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnSlider(
  value: _volume,
  min: 0,
  max: 1,
  step: 0.05,
  semanticLabel: 'Volume',
  onChanged: (double v) => setState(() => _volume = v),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Continuous

```dart
double _volume = 0.6;

CairnSlider(
  value: _volume,
  semanticLabel: 'Volume',
  onChanged: (double v) => setState(() => _volume = v),
)
```

### Stepped

```dart
double _zoom = 0.4;

CairnSlider(
  value: _zoom,
  step: 0.1,
  semanticLabel: 'Zoom',
  onChanged: (double v) => setState(() => _zoom = v),
)
```

## API

### `CairnSlider` (widget)

A value slider.

The track is `h-1.5 rounded-full bg-muted` (6 logical pixels), the filled
range is `bg-primary`, and the thumb is `size-4 rounded-full border
border-primary bg-white shadow-sm` — 16 logical pixels.

The thumb's fill is a literal white, **not** a token, so it stays white in
dark mode too. Mapping it to the background token would be the reflexive
choice and the wrong one: it would turn the thumb near-black on a dark page,
where it has to read as a control sitting on top of the track rather than a
hole punched through it.

Hover and keyboard focus both grow a `ring-4` (4px) halo at `ring-ring/50`
— note this is 4px, not the 3px ring the rest of the library uses.

## Accessibility

Arrow keys move by [step], Home and End jump to the bounds, and the
[Semantics] node exposes increase/decrease actions so screen readers can
drive it.

```dart
CairnSlider(
  value: volume,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => volume = v),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnSlider({required double value, ValueChanged<double>? onChanged, ValueChanged<double>? onChangeEnd, double min = 0.0, double max = 1.0, double? step, FocusNode? focusNode, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a slider.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `double` | yes |  | The current value, between [min] and [max]. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<double>?` |  |  | Called continuously as the user drags. Null disables the slider. |
| `onChangeEnd` | `ValueChanged<double>?` |  |  | Called once when a drag or keyboard interaction finishes. |
| `min` | `double` |  | `0.0` | The lower bound. |
| `max` | `double` |  | `1.0` | The upper bound. |
| `step` | `double?` |  |  | The increment for arrow keys and drag snapping. Null means continuous, with arrow keys moving by 1% of the range. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` |  |  | An externally supplied focus node. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. |

**Static members**

- `double trackHeight = 6.0` — `h-1.5`.
- `double thumbSize = 16.0` — `size-4`.
- `double ringWidth = 4.0` — `hover:ring-4` / `focus-visible:ring-4` — wider than the usual 3px.


---

# Toggle

A button that stays pressed.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnToggle`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

## Quick start

```dart
CairnToggle(
  value: _bold,
  variant: CairnToggleVariant.outline,
  onChanged: (bool v) => setState(() => _bold = v),
  child: const Text('Bold'),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Default

```dart
bool _bold = false;

CairnToggle(
  value: _bold,
  onChanged: (bool v) => setState(() => _bold = v),
  child: const Text('Bold'),
)
```

### Outline

```dart
bool _italic = true;

CairnToggle(
  value: _italic,
  variant: CairnToggleVariant.outline,
  onChanged: (bool v) => setState(() => _italic = v),
  child: const Text('Italic'),
)
```

## API

### `CairnToggle` (widget)

A two-state button.

`rounded-md text-sm font-medium hover:bg-muted hover:text-muted-foreground`,
switching to `bg-accent text-accent-foreground` when on.

Note the sizes use `min-w-*` rather than a fixed width, so a toggle holding
only an icon is square but one holding text grows — reproduced here with
[BoxConstraints.minWidth].

```dart
CairnToggle(
  value: bold,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => bold = v),
  child: const Text('B'),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnToggle({required bool value, required Widget child, ValueChanged<bool>? onChanged, CairnToggleVariant variant = CairnToggleVariant.normal, CairnToggleSize size = CairnToggleSize.md, FocusNode? focusNode, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a toggle.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `bool` | yes |  | Whether the toggle is on. |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | The toggle's content. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` |  |  | Called with the next value. Null disables the toggle. |
| `variant` | `CairnToggleVariant` |  | `CairnToggleVariant.normal` | The visual style. |
| `size` | `CairnToggleSize` |  | `CairnToggleSize.md` | The size. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` |  |  | An externally supplied focus node. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. |

### `CairnToggleVariant` (enum)

The visual style of a [CairnToggle].

- `CairnToggleVariant.normal` — `bg-transparent` — no border or fill at rest.
- `CairnToggleVariant.outline` — `border border-input bg-transparent shadow-xs`.

### `CairnToggleSize` (enum)

The size of a [CairnToggle].

- `CairnToggleSize.sm` — `h-8 min-w-8 px-1.5`.
- `CairnToggleSize.md` — `h-9 min-w-9 px-2`.
- `CairnToggleSize.lg` — `h-10 min-w-10 px-2.5`.

# Toggle Group

Joined or spaced toggles, single- or multi-select.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnToggleGroup`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

## Quick start

```dart
CairnToggleGroup<String>(
  values: _alignment,
  type: CairnToggleGroupType.single,
  variant: CairnToggleVariant.outline,
  onChanged: (Set<String> v) => setState(() => _alignment = v),
  items: const <CairnToggleGroupItem<String>>[
    CairnToggleGroupItem<String>(value: 'left', child: Text('Left')),
    CairnToggleGroupItem<String>(value: 'center', child: Text('Center')),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Single · outline

```dart
Set<String> _alignment = <String>{'center'};

CairnToggleGroup<String>(
  values: _alignment,
  variant: CairnToggleVariant.outline,
  onChanged: (Set<String> v) => setState(() => _alignment = v),
  items: const <CairnToggleGroupItem<String>>[
    CairnToggleGroupItem<String>(value: 'left', child: Text('Left')),
    CairnToggleGroupItem<String>(value: 'center', child: Text('Center')),
    CairnToggleGroupItem<String>(value: 'right', child: Text('Right')),
  ],
)
```

### Multiple

```dart
Set<String> _marks = <String>{'bold'};

CairnToggleGroup<String>(
  values: _marks,
  type: CairnToggleGroupType.multiple,
  onChanged: (Set<String> v) => setState(() => _marks = v),
  items: const <CairnToggleGroupItem<String>>[
    CairnToggleGroupItem<String>(value: 'bold', child: Text('B')),
    CairnToggleGroupItem<String>(value: 'italic', child: Text('I')),
    CairnToggleGroupItem<String>(value: 'underline', child: Text('U')),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnToggleGroup` (widget)

A set of related toggles, joined or spaced.

`flex w-fit items-center rounded-md`, with the joined (`data-[spacing=0]`)
presentation squaring off inner corners so the group reads as one control:
`first:rounded-l-md last:rounded-r-md` plus `border-l-0` on all but the
first item, which prevents the doubled 2px seam you would otherwise get
where two 1px borders meet.

```dart
CairnToggleGroup<String>(
  type: CairnToggleGroupType.single,
  values: {alignment},
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => alignment = v.firstOrNull ?? 'left'),
  items: const [
    CairnToggleGroupItem(value: 'left', child: Text('Left')),
    CairnToggleGroupItem(value: 'center', child: Text('Center')),
  ],
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnToggleGroup({required Set<T> values, required List<CairnToggleGroupItem<T>> items, ValueChanged<Set<T>>? onChanged, CairnToggleGroupType type = CairnToggleGroupType.single, CairnToggleVariant variant = CairnToggleVariant.normal, CairnToggleSize size = CairnToggleSize.md, bool joined = true, double spacing = 0.0, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a toggle group.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `values` | `Set<T>` | yes |  | The currently selected values. |
| `items` | `List<CairnToggleGroupItem<T>>` | yes |  | The items in this group. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<Set<T>>?` |  |  | Called with the next selection set. |
| `type` | `CairnToggleGroupType` |  | `CairnToggleGroupType.single` | Whether one or many items may be selected. |
| `variant` | `CairnToggleVariant` |  | `CairnToggleVariant.normal` | The visual style applied to every item. |
| `size` | `CairnToggleSize` |  | `CairnToggleSize.md` | The size applied to every item. |
| `joined` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether items are visually joined into one control. |
| `spacing` | `double` |  | `0.0` | The gap between items when not [joined]. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name for the group. |

### `CairnToggleGroupItem`

One option inside a [CairnToggleGroup].

**Constructor** `CairnToggleGroupItem({required T value, required Widget child, bool enabled = true, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a toggle group item.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `T` | yes |  | The value this item represents. |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | The item's content. |
| `enabled` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether this item is selectable. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. |

### `CairnToggleGroupType` (enum)

Whether a [CairnToggleGroup] allows one or many selections.

- `CairnToggleGroupType.single` — At most one item may be selected, like a radio group.
- `CairnToggleGroupType.multiple` — Any number of items may be selected.

# Input OTP

A grouped one-time-code field.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnInputOtp`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> One hidden text field sits behind painted slots, so paste and SMS autofill keep working. Only the first slot draws a left border, which avoids doubled hairlines.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnInputOtp(
  length: 6,
  groupSizes: const <int>[3, 3],
  onCompleted: _verify,
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Six digits · 3 + 3

```dart
CairnInputOtp(
  length: 6,
  groupSizes: const <int>[3, 3],
  onCompleted: (String code) => _verify(code),
)
```

### Four digits

```dart
CairnInputOtp(
  length: 4,
  onCompleted: (String code) => _verify(code),
)
```

## API

### `CairnInputOtp` (widget)

A one-time-code field.

Each slot is `h-9 w-9 border-y border-r border-input text-sm shadow-xs`,
with `first:rounded-l-md first:border-l last:rounded-r-md` — so the group
reads as a single joined control with **no doubled borders** between slots,
which is what the `border-r`-only rule achieves.

The active slot gets `border-ring ring-[3px] ring-ring/50` and shows a
blinking caret (`h-4 w-px animate-caret-blink duration-1000`).

## Implementation note

This is a single hidden [EditableText] behind a row of painted slots, not
one field per digit. Per-digit fields break paste, break the platform's SMS
autofill, and make backspace behave strangely — all of which the real
`input-otp` library also avoids by using one input.

```dart
CairnInputOtp(
  length: 6,
  onCompleted: (code) => verify(code),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnInputOtp({int length = 6, TextEditingController? controller, FocusNode? focusNode, ValueChanged<String>? onChanged, ValueChanged<String>? onCompleted, bool enabled = true, bool hasError = false, List<int>? groupSizes, bool autofocus = false})`

Creates a one-time-code field.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `length` | `int` |  | `6` | How many digits the code has. |
| `controller` | `TextEditingController?` |  |  | Controls the entered value. |
| `focusNode` | `FocusNode?` |  |  | An externally supplied focus node. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<String>?` |  |  | Called whenever the value changes. |
| `onCompleted` | `ValueChanged<String>?` |  |  | Called once the full code has been entered. |
| `enabled` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether input is accepted. |
| `hasError` | `bool` |  | `false` | Marks the control invalid. |
| `groupSizes` | `List<int>?` |  |  | Optional slot grouping, e.g. `[3, 3]` renders `123-456` with a gap. Must sum to [length]. Null renders one continuous group. |
| `autofocus` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to take focus on first build. |


---

# Form Field

Label, description and error layout around any control.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnFormField`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Layout only. Flutter already ships Form and FormField for validation; competing with them would fight the framework.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnFormField(
  label: 'Email',
  description: 'We will never share it.',
  error: _error,
  child: CairnInput(controller: _email, hasError: _error != null),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### With description

```dart
const CairnFormField(
  label: 'Email',
  description: 'We will never share it.',
  child: CairnInput(placeholder: 'name@example.com'),
)
```

### With error

```dart
const CairnFormField(
  label: 'Username',
  error: 'That name is already taken.',
  child: CairnInput(hasError: true),
)
```

## API

### `CairnFormField` (widget)

A labelled form row: label, control, description and error message.

The row is an 8px-gapped stack: a label that turns destructive when the
field is invalid, the control itself, a muted description, and the
validation message in its place.

Cairn deliberately ships the **layout wrapper only** and no validation
engine. Flutter already has [Form] and [FormField] with validators, and a
component library that invented a competing one would be fighting the
framework. [CairnFormField] therefore takes an [error] string that the
caller supplies from whatever state management it already uses.

```dart
CairnFormField(
  label: 'Email',
  description: 'We will never share it.',
  error: emailError,
  child: CairnInput(controller: controller, hasError: emailError != null),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnFormField({required Widget child, String? label, String? description, String? error, bool enabled = true})`

Creates a form field row.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | The control this row wraps. |
| `label` | `String?` |  |  | The field's label. |
| `description` | `String?` |  |  | Helper text shown below the control when there is no [error]. |
| `error` | `String?` |  |  | The validation error. Non-null switches the label to the destructive token and replaces [description]. |
| `enabled` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether the control is enabled; false dims the label. |


---

# Card

A surface with header, content and footer slots.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnCard`, `CairnCardHeader`, `CairnCardContent`, `CairnCardFooter`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> rounded-xl (14px) with py-6 on the card and px-6 on each slot, so a full-bleed child can still span edge to edge.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnCard(
  width: 360,
  children: <Widget>[
    const CairnCardHeader(
      title: Text('Deploy your project'),
      description: Text('Ship to production in one click.'),
    ),
    const CairnCardContent(child: Text('Ready to go live.')),
    CairnCardFooter(
      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
      children: <Widget>[
        CairnButton(onPressed: _deploy, child: const Text('Deploy')),
      ],
    ),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Header · content · footer

```dart
CairnCard(
  width: 360,
  children: <Widget>[
    const CairnCardHeader(
      title: Text('Deploy your project'),
      description: Text('Ship to production in one click.'),
    ),
    const CairnCardContent(
      child: Text(
        'Your changes have been reviewed and are ready to go live.',
      ),
    ),
    CairnCardFooter(
      mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.end,
      children: <Widget>[
        CairnButton(
          variant: CairnButtonVariant.outline,
          onPressed: () {},
          child: const Text('Cancel'),
        ),
        CairnButton(onPressed: () {}, child: const Text('Deploy')),
      ],
    ),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnCard` (widget)

A content container with header, content and footer slots.

`flex flex-col gap-6 rounded-xl border bg-card py-6 text-card-foreground
shadow-sm` — a `rounded-xl` (14 logical pixel) radius, 24px of vertical
padding on the card itself, and a 24px gap between its slots.

The horizontal padding lives on the *children* (`px-6` on header, content
and footer), not the card, which is what lets a full-bleed element such as
an image or a [CairnSeparator] span edge to edge. Cairn preserves that
structure rather than collapsing it into one padded box.

```dart
CairnCard(
  children: [
    const CairnCardHeader(
      title: Text('Deploy'),
      description: Text('Push to production.'),
    ),
    const CairnCardContent(child: Text('Body')),
    CairnCardFooter(
      children: [CairnButton(onPressed: () {}, child: const Text('Go'))],
    ),
  ],
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnCard({required List<Widget> children, double gap = CairnSpacing.s6, double? width})`

Creates a card.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | yes |  | The card's slots, typically [CairnCardHeader], [CairnCardContent] and [CairnCardFooter]. |
| `gap` | `double` |  | `CairnSpacing.s6` | The gap between slots (`gap-6`). |
| `width` | `double?` |  |  | An optional fixed width. |

### `CairnCardHeader` (widget)

The title and description slot of a [CairnCard].

`grid auto-rows-min items-start gap-2 px-6`, with an optional [action]
pinned to the trailing edge (`col-start-2 row-span-2 justify-self-end`).

**Constructor** `CairnCardHeader({Widget? title, Widget? description, Widget? action})`

Creates a card header.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Widget?` |  |  | The card title — `leading-none font-semibold`. |
| `description` | `Widget?` |  |  | The supporting description — `text-sm text-muted-foreground`. |
| `action` | `Widget?` |  |  | An optional trailing action, such as a menu button. |

### `CairnCardContent` (widget)

The main body slot of a [CairnCard] — `px-6`.

**Constructor** `CairnCardContent({required Widget child})`

Creates a card content slot.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | The body. |

### `CairnCardFooter` (widget)

The footer slot of a [CairnCard] — `flex items-center px-6`.

**Constructor** `CairnCardFooter({required List<Widget> children, double spacing = CairnSpacing.s2, MainAxisAlignment mainAxisAlignment = MainAxisAlignment.start})`

Creates a card footer.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | yes |  | The footer's children, typically buttons. |
| `spacing` | `double` |  | `CairnSpacing.s2` | The gap between children. |
| `mainAxisAlignment` | `MainAxisAlignment` |  | `MainAxisAlignment.start` | How to align the children horizontally. |

# Badge

A small status pill in five variants.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnBadge`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Filled variants carry a transparent 1px border so their outer size is identical to the outline variant.

## Quick start

```dart
const CairnBadge(
  variant: CairnBadgeVariant.secondary,
  leading: CairnIcon(CairnIconData.check, size: 12),
  label: Text('Verified'),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Primary

```dart
const CairnBadge(label: Text('Default'))
```

### Secondary

```dart
const CairnBadge(
  variant: CairnBadgeVariant.secondary,
  label: Text('Secondary'),
)
```

### Destructive

```dart
const CairnBadge(
  variant: CairnBadgeVariant.destructive,
  label: Text('Destructive'),
)
```

### Outline

```dart
const CairnBadge(
  variant: CairnBadgeVariant.outline,
  label: Text('Outline'),
)
```

### Ghost

```dart
const CairnBadge(
  variant: CairnBadgeVariant.ghost,
  label: Text('Ghost'),
)
```

### With icon

```dart
const CairnBadge(
  leading: CairnIcon(CairnIconData.check, size: 12),
  label: Text('Verified'),
)
```

## API

### `CairnBadge` (widget)

A small status pill.

`inline-flex w-fit items-center gap-1 rounded-full border border-transparent
px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium` — a fully rounded pill with 8px horizontal
and 2px vertical padding and 12px medium text.

The transparent 1px border on filled variants is deliberate: it keeps the
outer dimensions identical between the filled and [CairnBadgeVariant.outline]
variants, so badges of different variants line up in a row.

```dart
const CairnBadge(label: Text('Beta'));
const CairnBadge(
  variant: CairnBadgeVariant.destructive,
  label: Text('Failed'),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnBadge({required Widget label, CairnBadgeVariant variant = CairnBadgeVariant.primary, Widget? leading, Widget? trailing})`

Creates a badge.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `Widget` | yes |  | The badge's content. |
| `variant` | `CairnBadgeVariant` |  | `CairnBadgeVariant.primary` | The visual style. |
| `leading` | `Widget?` |  |  | An icon before the label. Forced to `size-3` (12px). |
| `trailing` | `Widget?` |  |  | An icon after the label. Forced to `size-3` (12px). |

### `CairnBadgeVariant` (enum)

The visual style of a [CairnBadge].

- `CairnBadgeVariant.primary` — `bg-primary text-primary-foreground`.
- `CairnBadgeVariant.secondary` — `bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground`.
- `CairnBadgeVariant.destructive` — `bg-destructive text-white`.
- `CairnBadgeVariant.outline` — `border-border text-foreground` with no fill.
- `CairnBadgeVariant.ghost` — No fill and no border.

# Avatar

A user image with a persistent fallback, plus a stack group.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnAvatar`, `CairnAvatarGroup`, `CairnAvatarGroup`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> The fallback survives an image error rather than leaving a hole, which is the case naive implementations miss.

## Quick start

```dart
const CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('CA'), size: CairnAvatarSize.lg)

const CairnAvatarGroup(
  children: <Widget>[
    CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('A')),
    CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('B')),
    CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('+7')),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Small

```dart
const CairnAvatar(
  size: CairnAvatarSize.sm,
  fallback: Text('RJ'),
)
```

### Medium

```dart
const CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('CA'))
```

### Large

```dart
const CairnAvatar(
  size: CairnAvatarSize.lg,
  fallback: Text('UI'),
)
```

### Group

```dart
const CairnAvatarGroup(
  children: <Widget>[
    CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('A')),
    CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('B')),
    CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('+7')),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnAvatar` (widget)

A user avatar with an image and a text fallback.

`relative flex size-8 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-full select-none`,
with a `bg-muted text-sm text-muted-foreground` fallback.

[fallback] stays visible until the image has actually loaded, and the swap
happens only on success — so a broken URL leaves the initials in place
rather than collapsing to a broken-image box, and a slow one never flashes
an empty circle. That is why the image runs through [Image.errorBuilder] and
[Image.frameBuilder] instead of simply being stacked over the fallback.

```dart
CairnAvatar(
  image: const NetworkImage('https://example.com/me.jpg'),
  fallback: const Text('RJ'),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnAvatar({ImageProvider<Object>? image, Widget? fallback, CairnAvatarSize size = CairnAvatarSize.md, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates an avatar.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `image` | `ImageProvider<Object>?` |  |  | The avatar image. Falls back to [fallback] while loading or on error. |
| `fallback` | `Widget?` |  |  | Shown when [image] is null, still loading, or failed. |
| `size` | `CairnAvatarSize` |  | `CairnAvatarSize.md` | The size. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. |

### `CairnAvatarGroup` (widget)

A row of overlapping avatars.

`flex -space-x-2 *:ring-2 *:ring-background` — each avatar overlaps the
previous by 8 logical pixels and carries a 2px ring in the page background
colour, which is what separates them visually.

CSS achieves the overlap with a negative margin. Flutter's [Padding] asserts
non-negative insets, so this lays the avatars out in a [Stack] with computed
offsets instead and sizes the box explicitly — which also lets the first
avatar paint on top, matching the CSS stacking order.

```dart
const CairnAvatarGroup(
  size: CairnAvatarSize.md,
  children: [
    CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('RJ')),
    CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('AB')),
    CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('+3')),
  ],
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnAvatarGroup({required List<Widget> children, CairnAvatarSize size = CairnAvatarSize.md, double overlap = 8.0, double ringWidth = 2.0})`

Creates an avatar group.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | yes |  | The avatars, drawn left to right with the first on top. |
| `size` | `CairnAvatarSize` |  | `CairnAvatarSize.md` | The size of every avatar in the group. |
| `overlap` | `double` |  | `8.0` | How far each avatar overlaps the previous (`-space-x-2`). |
| `ringWidth` | `double` |  | `2.0` | The separating ring width (`ring-2`). |

### `CairnAvatarSize` (enum)

The size of a [CairnAvatar].

- `CairnAvatarSize.sm` — `size-6` — 24 logical pixels, with `text-xs` fallback text.
- `CairnAvatarSize.md` — `size-8` — 32 logical pixels.
- `CairnAvatarSize.lg` — `size-10` — 40 logical pixels.


---

# Alert

An inline banner, default or destructive.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnAlert`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> The icon is nudged down 2px (translate-y-0.5) so it aligns to the title cap height rather than its line box.

## Quick start

```dart
const CairnAlert(
  variant: CairnAlertVariant.destructive,
  icon: CairnIcon(CairnIconData.alert),
  title: Text('Payment failed'),
  description: Text('Update your billing details to continue.'),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Default

```dart
const CairnAlert(
  icon: CairnIcon(CairnIconData.info),
  title: Text('Heads up'),
  description: Text('Your trial ends in three days.'),
)
```

### Destructive

```dart
const CairnAlert(
  variant: CairnAlertVariant.destructive,
  icon: CairnIcon(CairnIconData.alert),
  title: Text('Payment failed'),
  description: Text('Update your billing details to continue.'),
)
```

## API

### `CairnAlert` (widget)

A callout for a short, prominent message.

`relative grid w-full items-start rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 text-sm`.

The layout is a CSS grid whose first column collapses to zero width when
there is no icon (`grid-cols-[0_1fr]`) and becomes 16px wide with a 12px
gap when there is (`has-[>svg]:grid-cols-[calc(var(--spacing)*4)_1fr]
has-[>svg]:gap-x-3`). The icon is also nudged down 2px
(`[&>svg]:translate-y-0.5`) so it optically aligns with the title's cap
height rather than its line box. Both details are reproduced here.

```dart
const CairnAlert(
  icon: CairnIcon(CairnIconData.alert),
  title: Text('Heads up!'),
  description: Text('Your trial ends in three days.'),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnAlert({Widget? title, Widget? description, Widget? icon, CairnAlertVariant variant = CairnAlertVariant.normal})`

Creates an alert.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Widget?` |  |  | The alert heading — `font-medium tracking-tight`. |
| `description` | `Widget?` |  |  | The supporting body — `text-sm text-muted-foreground`. |
| `icon` | `Widget?` |  |  | An optional leading icon, forced to `size-4` (16px). |
| `variant` | `CairnAlertVariant` |  | `CairnAlertVariant.normal` | The visual style. |

### `CairnAlertVariant` (enum)

The visual style of a [CairnAlert].

- `CairnAlertVariant.normal` — `bg-card text-card-foreground`.
- `CairnAlertVariant.destructive` — `bg-card text-destructive`, with the description at `text-destructive/90`.


---

# Separator

A hairline rule, horizontal or vertical.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnSeparator`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Decorative by default, so screen readers skip it; pass decorative: false when the rule carries meaning.

## Quick start

```dart
const CairnSeparator()

const CairnSeparator(axis: Axis.vertical, decorative: false)
```

## Variants and examples

### Horizontal

```dart
const Column(
  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
  spacing: CairnSpacing.s4,
  children: <Widget>[
    Text('Cairn UI'),
    CairnSeparator(),
  ],
)
```

### Vertical

```dart
const SizedBox(
  height: 20,
  child: Row(
    spacing: CairnSpacing.s4,
    children: <Widget>[
      Text('Docs'),
      CairnSeparator(axis: Axis.vertical),
      Text('Components'),
      CairnSeparator(axis: Axis.vertical),
      Text('Blocks'),
    ],
  ),
)
```

## API

### `CairnSeparator` (widget)

A one-pixel rule.

`shrink-0 bg-border`, `h-px w-full` when horizontal and `h-full w-px` when
vertical.

The thickness is a literal CSS `1px`, which is one *logical* pixel in
Flutter — so on a 3x device it rasterises to three physical pixels, exactly
as a browser would on the same display.

[decorative] decides whether the rule is announced. Most separators are
pure visual rhythm and should be hidden from assistive technology; one that
genuinely divides two sections of content is a semantic boundary and is
announced as such.

```dart
const CairnSeparator();
const CairnSeparator(axis: Axis.vertical);
```

**Constructor** `CairnSeparator({Axis axis = Axis.horizontal, bool decorative = true, double thickness = 1.0, Color? color})`

Creates a separator.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` | `Axis` |  | `Axis.horizontal` | The orientation. Horizontal fills width; vertical fills height. |
| `decorative` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether to hide this from assistive technology. |
| `thickness` | `double` |  | `1.0` | The rule thickness in logical pixels (`h-px` / `w-px`). |
| `color` | `Color?` |  |  | Overrides the `--border` token. |


---

# Skeleton

A pulsing placeholder for loading content.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnSkeleton`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Uses Tailwind's animate-pulse curve and honours MediaQuery.disableAnimations.

## Quick start

```dart
const Row(
  children: <Widget>[
    CairnSkeleton.circle(size: 44),
    SizedBox(width: 16),
    CairnSkeleton(width: 220, height: 12),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Circle

```dart
const CairnSkeleton.circle(size: 44)
```

### Text lines

```dart
const Column(
  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
  spacing: CairnSpacing.s2,
  children: <Widget>[
    CairnSkeleton(width: 220, height: 12),
    CairnSkeleton(width: 160, height: 12),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnSkeleton` (widget)

A loading placeholder.

`animate-pulse rounded-md bg-accent`.

Tailwind's `animate-pulse` keyframes run `opacity: 1 -> .5 -> 1` over two
seconds with `cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1)`. This reproduces that curve
rather than using a shimmer, because a shimmer is a different effect that
would not match.

Respects [MediaQueryData.disableAnimations], so users who have asked their
platform to reduce motion get a static placeholder.

```dart
const CairnSkeleton(width: 200, height: 16);
const CairnSkeleton.circle(size: 40);
```

**Constructor** `CairnSkeleton({double? width, double? height, BorderRadius? borderRadius})`

Creates a rectangular skeleton.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | `double?` |  |  | The width. Null fills the available width. |
| `height` | `double?` |  |  | The height. |
| `borderRadius` | `BorderRadius?` |  |  | Overrides `rounded-md`. |

**Constructor** `CairnSkeleton.circle({required double size})`

Creates a circular skeleton, for avatar placeholders.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `double` | yes |  |  |

# Spinner

An indeterminate activity indicator.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnSpinner`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> animate-spin at 1s, linear. Respects reduced motion.

## Quick start

```dart
const CairnSpinner(size: 24, strokeWidth: 2)
```

## Variants and examples

### 16px (default)

```dart
const CairnSpinner()
```

### 24px

```dart
const CairnSpinner(size: 24)
```

### 32px · 3px stroke

```dart
const CairnSpinner(size: 32, strokeWidth: 3)
```

## API

### `CairnSpinner` (widget)

A loading spinner.

`size-4 animate-spin` — a 16 logical pixel arc rotating once per second at
a linear rate, matching Tailwind's `animate-spin` keyframes exactly (a
constant-speed 360-degree rotation, not an eased one).

```dart
const CairnSpinner();
CairnButton(
  onPressed: null,
  leading: const CairnSpinner(),
  child: const Text('Saving'),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnSpinner({double size = 16.0, Color? color, double strokeWidth = 2.0, String semanticLabel = 'Loading'})`

Creates a spinner.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `size` | `double` |  | `16.0` | The diameter (`size-4`). |
| `color` | `Color?` |  |  | The arc colour. Defaults to the ambient text colour. |
| `strokeWidth` | `double` |  | `2.0` | The arc thickness. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String` |  | `'Loading'` | The accessible name. |

# Kbd

Keyboard key hints, single or grouped.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnKbd`, `CairnKbdGroup`, `CairnKbdGroup`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> font-sans, not monospace — a detail that is easy to get wrong from memory because every other design system uses a mono face here.

## Quick start

```dart
const CairnKbd('Esc')

const CairnKbdGroup(keys: <String>['Ctrl', 'K'])
```

## Variants and examples

### Single key

```dart
const CairnKbd('Esc')
```

### Two-key group

```dart
const CairnKbdGroup(keys: <String>['Ctrl', 'K'])
```

### Three-key group

```dart
const CairnKbdGroup(keys: <String>['Shift', 'Alt', 'D'])
```

## API

### `CairnKbd` (widget)

A keyboard shortcut chip.

`pointer-events-none inline-flex h-5 w-fit min-w-5 items-center justify-center
gap-1 rounded-sm bg-muted px-1 font-sans text-xs font-medium
text-muted-foreground select-none` — a 20 logical pixel tall chip with a
`min-w-5` so a single character still renders square.

Note the face is the ambient sans, deliberately **not** a monospace one.
A key chip is a label, not code, and monospace digits next to sans-serif
body text read as a mistake at this size.

```dart
const CairnKbdGroup(keys: ['Ctrl', 'K']);
```

**Constructor** `CairnKbd(String label)`

Creates a single key chip.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | yes |  | The key's text, such as `Ctrl` or `K`. |

### `CairnKbdGroup` (widget)

A run of [CairnKbd] chips — `inline-flex items-center gap-1`.

**Constructor** `CairnKbdGroup({required List<String> keys})`

Creates a group of key chips.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `keys` | `List<String>` | yes |  | The keys, in press order. |


---

# Aspect Ratio

Constrains a child to a fixed ratio.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnAspectRatio`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> A thin wrapper over Flutter's own AspectRatio, with clipping.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnAspectRatio(
  ratio: 16 / 9,
  child: Image.network(url, fit: BoxFit.cover),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### 16 : 9

```dart
SizedBox(
  width: 280,
  child: CairnAspectRatio(
    ratio: 16 / 9,
    child: Image.network(url, fit: BoxFit.cover),
  ),
)
```

### 1 : 1

```dart
SizedBox(
  width: 160,
  child: CairnAspectRatio(
    ratio: 1,
    child: Image.network(url, fit: BoxFit.cover),
  ),
)
```

## API

### `CairnAspectRatio` (widget)

Constrains a child to a fixed aspect ratio.

Flutter's own [AspectRatio] already does this correctly, so this is a thin,
documented wrapper rather than a reimplementation — there is nothing here to
improve on. It exists so the Cairn surface stays complete: a
ratio-constrained box inside a Card is reached for by the same name as
everything around it.

```dart
CairnAspectRatio(
  ratio: 16 / 9,
  child: Image.network('https://example.com/cover.jpg', fit: BoxFit.cover),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnAspectRatio({required double ratio, required Widget child, bool clip = true})`

Creates an aspect-ratio box.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ratio` | `double` | yes |  | Width divided by height, e.g. `16 / 9`. |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | The constrained child. |
| `clip` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether to clip the child to the box (`overflow-hidden`). |


---

# Empty

The zero-state panel, with a dashed border.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnEmpty`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> The dashed border is hand-painted — Flutter's Border has no dash support, so a CustomPainter walks the rounded rect.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnEmpty(
  media: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.search, size: 32),
  title: 'No results',
  description: 'Try adjusting your filters.',
  actions: <Widget>[
    CairnButton(
      variant: CairnButtonVariant.outline,
      onPressed: _clear,
      child: const Text('Clear filters'),
    ),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### No results

```dart
CairnEmpty(
  media: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.search, size: 32),
  title: 'No results',
  description: 'Try adjusting your filters, or clear them to start over.',
  actions: <Widget>[
    CairnButton(
      variant: CairnButtonVariant.outline,
      onPressed: () {},
      child: const Text('Clear filters'),
    ),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnEmpty` (widget)

An empty-state placeholder.

`flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-6 rounded-lg border-dashed
p-6 text-center md:p-12` with a `size-16 rounded-md bg-muted` media slot, a
`text-lg font-medium tracking-tight` title and a
`text-sm/relaxed text-muted-foreground` description.

Note the border is **dashed**, which Flutter's [Border] cannot draw — see
the custom painter below.

```dart
CairnEmpty(
  media: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.search, size: 32),
  title: 'No results',
  description: 'Try adjusting your filters.',
  actions: [CairnButton(onPressed: () {}, child: const Text('Reset'))],
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnEmpty({String? title, String? description, Widget? media, List<Widget> actions = const <Widget>[], bool bordered = true})`

Creates an empty state.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String?` |  |  | The heading. |
| `description` | `String?` |  |  | The supporting text. |
| `media` | `Widget?` |  |  | An icon or illustration, shown in a `size-16 bg-muted` tile. |
| `actions` | `List<Widget>` |  | `const <Widget>[]` | Actions below the text. |
| `bordered` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether to draw the dashed border. |
