# Pagination

A windowed page range with ellipses.

- Category: Navigation
- Widgets: `CairnPagination`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

## Quick start

```dart
CairnPagination(
  page: _page,
  pageCount: 12,
  siblingCount: 1,
  onChanged: (int p) => setState(() => _page = p),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Page 4 of 12

```dart
int _page = 4;

CairnPagination(
  page: _page,
  pageCount: 12,
  onChanged: (int p) => setState(() => _page = p),
)
```

## API

### `CairnPagination` (widget)

A page navigator.

`flex flex-row items-center gap-1` — page links reuse the Button styles:
the current page is the `outline` variant and the rest are `ghost`, all at
the `size-9` icon size. Previous and Next are wider (`px-2.5`) because they
carry a label alongside the chevron.

Renders a windowed range with ellipses so the control stays a fixed width
regardless of page count.

```dart
CairnPagination(
  page: page,
  pageCount: 20,
  onChanged: (p) => setState(() => page = p),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnPagination({required int page, required int pageCount, ValueChanged<int>? onChanged, int siblingCount = 1, bool showLabels = true})`

Creates a pagination control.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page` | `int` | yes |  | The current page, 1-based. |
| `pageCount` | `int` | yes |  | The total number of pages. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<int>?` |  |  | Called with the requested page. |
| `siblingCount` | `int` |  | `1` | How many pages to show either side of the current one. |
| `showLabels` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether Previous and Next show text labels. |


---

# Menubar

A desktop menu bar with hover-to-switch behaviour.

- Category: Navigation
- Widgets: `CairnMenubar`, `CairnNavigationMenu`, `CairnNavigationMenu`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Once one menu is open, hovering a sibling switches to it without a click — as every native menu bar does.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnMenubar(
  menus: <CairnMenubarMenu>[
    CairnMenubarMenu(
      label: 'File',
      items: <Widget>[
        CairnMenuItem(
          onPressed: _newTab,
          shortcut: 'Ctrl+N',
          child: const Text('New tab'),
        ),
      ],
    ),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### File · Edit · View

```dart
CairnMenubar(
  menus: <CairnMenubarMenu>[
    CairnMenubarMenu(
      label: 'File',
      items: <Widget>[
        CairnMenuItem(
          onPressed: () {},
          shortcut: 'Ctrl+N',
          child: const Text('New tab'),
        ),
        CairnMenuItem(
          onPressed: () {},
          shortcut: 'Ctrl+O',
          child: const Text('Open...'),
        ),
        const CairnMenuSeparator(),
        CairnMenuItem(onPressed: () {}, child: const Text('Print')),
      ],
    ),
    CairnMenubarMenu(
      label: 'Edit',
      items: <Widget>[
        CairnMenuItem(
          onPressed: () {},
          shortcut: 'Ctrl+Z',
          child: const Text('Undo'),
        ),
        CairnMenuItem(
          onPressed: () {},
          shortcut: 'Ctrl+Y',
          child: const Text('Redo'),
        ),
      ],
    ),
    CairnMenubarMenu(
      label: 'View',
      items: <Widget>[
        CairnMenuItem(onPressed: () {}, child: const Text('Reload')),
      ],
    ),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnMenubarMenu`

One top-level menu in a [CairnMenubar].

**Constructor** `CairnMenubarMenu({required String label, required List<Widget> items, bool enabled = true})`

Creates a menubar menu.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | yes |  | The trigger's text, e.g. `File`. |
| `items` | `List<Widget>` | yes |  | The menu's rows, typically [CairnMenuItem]s. |
| `enabled` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether the menu can be opened. |

### `CairnMenubar` (widget)

A desktop-style menu bar.

The bar is `flex h-9 items-center gap-1 rounded-md border bg-background p-1
shadow-xs`; triggers are `rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-sm font-medium` and
highlight with `data-[state=open]:bg-accent`. Panels are `min-w-[12rem]`
(192 logical pixels) — wider than a Dropdown Menu's `min-w-[8rem]`.

## The hover-to-switch behaviour

Once any menu in the bar is open, hovering a sibling trigger switches to it
without a click — the behaviour every native menu bar has. That requires
the open state to live in the *bar*, not in each menu, so Cairn keeps a
single active index in the parent rather than one controller per menu.
Per-menu state would make "close that one and open this one" a coordination
problem with a visible flicker in the middle of it.

```dart
CairnMenubar(
  menus: [
    CairnMenubarMenu(
      label: 'File',
      items: [CairnMenuItem(onPressed: () {}, child: const Text('New'))],
    ),
  ],
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnMenubar({required List<CairnMenubarMenu> menus, double minPanelWidth = 192.0})`

Creates a menu bar.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `menus` | `List<CairnMenubarMenu>` | yes |  | The top-level menus. |
| `minPanelWidth` | `double` |  | `192.0` | `min-w-[12rem]`. |

### `CairnNavigationMenu` (widget)

A horizontal navigation bar.

Triggers are `h-9 w-max rounded-md bg-background px-4 py-2 text-sm
font-medium` with `hover:bg-accent`, and the open state is
`data-[state=open]:bg-accent/50`. Content panels are `rounded-md border
bg-popover p-2 shadow`.

Distinct from [CairnMenubar]: a navigation menu's panels hold arbitrary
content (link grids, promos), not just menu rows, and it is a site-navigation
pattern rather than an application menu bar.

**Constructor** `CairnNavigationMenu({required List<CairnNavigationItem> items})`

Creates a navigation menu.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CairnNavigationItem>` | yes |  | The top-level entries. |

### `CairnNavigationItem`

One entry in a [CairnNavigationMenu].

**Constructor** `CairnNavigationItem({required String label, VoidCallback? onPressed, Widget? content})`

Creates a plain link that fires [onPressed].

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | yes |  | The trigger's text. |
| `onPressed` | `VoidCallback?` |  |  | Called when a link-style entry is activated. |
| `content` | `Widget?` |  |  | A panel shown on activation. Non-null makes this a disclosure trigger rather than a link. |


---

# Navigation Menu

A top-level nav with arbitrary dropdown panels.

- Category: Navigation
- Widgets: `CairnMenubar`, `CairnNavigationMenu`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

## Quick start

```dart
CairnNavigationMenu(
  items: <CairnNavigationItem>[
    CairnNavigationItem(
      label: 'Getting started',
      content: const SizedBox(width: 300, child: Text('Introduction')),
    ),
    CairnNavigationItem(label: 'Docs', onPressed: _docs),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Getting started

```dart
CairnNavigationMenu(
  items: <CairnNavigationItem>[
    CairnNavigationItem(
      label: 'Getting started',
      content: SizedBox(
        width: 300,
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          spacing: CairnSpacing.s2,
          children: <Widget>[
            Text(
              'Introduction',
              style: theme
                  .textStyle(CairnTypography.sm)
                  .copyWith(fontWeight: CairnTypography.medium),
            ),
            Text(
              'Sixty-five components on one token layer, in Flutter.',
              style: theme
                  .textStyle(CairnTypography.sm)
                  .copyWith(color: theme.mutedForeground),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    ),
    CairnNavigationItem(label: 'Docs', onPressed: () {}),
    CairnNavigationItem(label: 'Blocks', onPressed: () {}),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnMenubarMenu`

One top-level menu in a [CairnMenubar].

**Constructor** `CairnMenubarMenu({required String label, required List<Widget> items, bool enabled = true})`

Creates a menubar menu.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | yes |  | The trigger's text, e.g. `File`. |
| `items` | `List<Widget>` | yes |  | The menu's rows, typically [CairnMenuItem]s. |
| `enabled` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether the menu can be opened. |

### `CairnMenubar` (widget)

A desktop-style menu bar.

The bar is `flex h-9 items-center gap-1 rounded-md border bg-background p-1
shadow-xs`; triggers are `rounded-sm px-2 py-1 text-sm font-medium` and
highlight with `data-[state=open]:bg-accent`. Panels are `min-w-[12rem]`
(192 logical pixels) — wider than a Dropdown Menu's `min-w-[8rem]`.

## The hover-to-switch behaviour

Once any menu in the bar is open, hovering a sibling trigger switches to it
without a click — the behaviour every native menu bar has. That requires
the open state to live in the *bar*, not in each menu, so Cairn keeps a
single active index in the parent rather than one controller per menu.
Per-menu state would make "close that one and open this one" a coordination
problem with a visible flicker in the middle of it.

```dart
CairnMenubar(
  menus: [
    CairnMenubarMenu(
      label: 'File',
      items: [CairnMenuItem(onPressed: () {}, child: const Text('New'))],
    ),
  ],
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnMenubar({required List<CairnMenubarMenu> menus, double minPanelWidth = 192.0})`

Creates a menu bar.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `menus` | `List<CairnMenubarMenu>` | yes |  | The top-level menus. |
| `minPanelWidth` | `double` |  | `192.0` | `min-w-[12rem]`. |

### `CairnNavigationMenu` (widget)

A horizontal navigation bar.

Triggers are `h-9 w-max rounded-md bg-background px-4 py-2 text-sm
font-medium` with `hover:bg-accent`, and the open state is
`data-[state=open]:bg-accent/50`. Content panels are `rounded-md border

Distinct from [CairnMenubar]: a navigation menu's panels hold arbitrary
content (link grids, promos), not just menu rows, and it is a site-navigation
pattern rather than an application menu bar.

**Constructor** `CairnNavigationMenu({required List<CairnNavigationItem> items})`

Creates a navigation menu.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CairnNavigationItem>` | yes |  | The top-level entries. |

### `CairnNavigationItem`

One entry in a [CairnNavigationMenu].

**Constructor** `CairnNavigationItem({required String label, VoidCallback? onPressed, Widget? content})`

Creates a plain link that fires [onPressed].

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

# Scroll Area

A scroller with a thumb drawn from the theme's tokens.

- Category: Navigation
- Widgets: `CairnScrollArea`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Configures Flutter's own Scrollbar rather than reimplementing scrolling: the thumb is bg-border on a w-2.5 track.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnScrollArea(
  height: 200,
  alwaysVisible: true,
  child: Column(children: tags),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Vertical, always visible

```dart
CairnScrollArea(
  height: 160,
  alwaysVisible: true,
  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: CairnSpacing.s4),
  child: Column(
    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
    children: <Widget>[
      for (int i = 1; i <= 18; i++) ...<Widget>[
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: CairnSpacing.s2),
          child: Text('Tag $i'),
        ),
        if (i != 18) const CairnSeparator(),
      ],
    ],
  ),
)
```

## API

### `CairnScrollArea` (widget)

A scroll container with a slim, quiet scrollbar.

The scrollbar track is `w-2.5` (10 logical pixels) with `p-px` padding and
the thumb is `rounded-full bg-border` — noticeably slimmer and quieter than
a platform scrollbar, which is the point of the component.

This configures Flutter's [Scrollbar] rather than reimplementing scrolling.
The web has to hand-roll a scrollbar to restyle one; Flutter does not, and
reimplementing here would give up momentum physics, trackpad handling and
accessibility for no visual gain whatsoever.

```dart
CairnScrollArea(
  height: 200,
  child: Column(children: items),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnScrollArea({required Widget child, double? height, double? width, Axis axis = Axis.vertical, EdgeInsetsGeometry? padding, bool alwaysVisible = false})`

Creates a scroll area.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | The scrollable content. |
| `height` | `double?` |  |  | An optional fixed height. |
| `width` | `double?` |  |  | An optional fixed width. |
| `axis` | `Axis` |  | `Axis.vertical` | The scroll direction. |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry?` |  |  | Padding applied inside the scroll view. |
| `alwaysVisible` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether the scrollbar stays visible rather than fading out. |


---

# Carousel

A paged viewport with controls and indicators.

- Category: Navigation
- Widgets: `CairnCarousel`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

## Quick start

```dart
CairnCarousel(
  height: 200,
  viewportFraction: 0.8,
  items: slides,
  onPageChanged: (int i) => setState(() => _page = i),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Five slides

```dart
CairnCarousel(
  height: 150,
  items: <Widget>[
    for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++)
      DecoratedBox(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          color: theme.muted,
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(theme.radiusScale.lg),
        ),
        child: Center(child: Text('$i')),
      ),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnCarousel` (widget)

A horizontally paged content strip.

The previous/next controls are 32 logical pixel round outline buttons that
sit *outside* the viewport edges rather than floating over the content, so
they never cover part of a slide. The trade-off is worth stating plainly:
the carousel needs horizontal room around it.

The strip itself is a [PageView]. Flutter's scroll physics, drag handling
and page snapping are already right, and anything hand-rolled would only be
a worse version of them — so the component's substance is its chrome, its
metrics and its keyboard behaviour.

```dart
CairnCarousel(
  height: 200,
  items: [for (final image in images) Image.network(image)],
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnCarousel({required List<Widget> items, double height = 200.0, double viewportFraction = 1.0, double spacing = CairnSpacing.s4, bool showControls = true, bool showIndicators = true, ValueChanged<int>? onPageChanged})`

Creates a carousel.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<Widget>` | yes |  | The slides. |
| `height` | `double` |  | `200.0` | The strip height. |
| `viewportFraction` | `double` |  | `1.0` | How much of the viewport one slide occupies. Below 1.0 the neighbouring slides peek in at the edges, hinting that the strip continues. |
| `spacing` | `double` |  | `CairnSpacing.s4` | The gap between slides, in logical pixels. |
| `showControls` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether to show the previous/next buttons. |
| `showIndicators` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether to show the dot indicators. |
| `onPageChanged` | `ValueChanged<int>?` |  |  | Called when the visible page changes. |


---

# Progress

Determinate and indeterminate progress bars.

- Category: Data & feedback
- Widgets: `CairnProgress`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> The track is the primary colour at 20% alpha, not the muted token — a detail that is invisible until you put the two side by side.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnProgress(value: _uploaded, semanticLabel: 'Upload')

const CairnProgress(semanticLabel: 'Working')
```

## Variants and examples

### Determinate

```dart
const CairnProgress(value: 0.62, semanticLabel: 'Upload')
```

### Indeterminate

```dart
const CairnProgress(semanticLabel: 'Working')
```

## API

### `CairnProgress` (widget)

A progress bar, determinate or indeterminate.

An 8 logical pixel fully-rounded track carrying a primary-coloured
indicator. The track is the primary colour at 20% alpha rather than the
muted token, so the filled and unfilled halves read as one object at two
strengths instead of two unrelated greys.

Passing null to [value] renders an indeterminate bar, for the very common
case of work whose duration is not known up front.

```dart
const CairnProgress(value: 0.6);
const CairnProgress(); // indeterminate
```

**Constructor** `CairnProgress({double? value, double height = 8.0, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a progress bar.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `double?` |  |  | Progress from 0 to 1, or null for indeterminate. |
| `height` | `double` |  | `8.0` | The track height (`h-2`). |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. |


---

# Toast

Stacked notifications that outlive the route that fired them.

- Category: Data & feedback
- Widgets: `CairnToaster`, `CairnToaster`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> CairnToaster is installed in MaterialApp.builder, above the Navigator, so a toast fired from a screen survives that screen being popped.

## Quick start

```dart
MaterialApp(
  builder: (BuildContext context, Widget? child) =>
      CairnToaster(child: child!),
);

CairnToast.show(
  context,
  const CairnToast(
    variant: CairnToastVariant.success,
    title: 'Changes saved',
    description: 'Your profile is up to date.',
  ),
);
```

## Variants and examples

### Default

```dart
// CairnToaster is installed once, in MaterialApp.builder:
//   builder: (context, child) => CairnToaster(child: child!),

CairnButton(
  variant: CairnButtonVariant.outline,
  size: CairnButtonSize.sm,
  onPressed: () => CairnToast.show(
    context,
    const CairnToast(
      title: 'Event created',
      description: 'Friday, 12 September at 9:00 AM.',
    ),
  ),
  child: const Text('Default'),
)
```

### Success

```dart
CairnButton(
  variant: CairnButtonVariant.outline,
  size: CairnButtonSize.sm,
  onPressed: () => CairnToast.show(
    context,
    const CairnToast(
      variant: CairnToastVariant.success,
      title: 'Changes saved',
      description: 'Your profile is up to date.',
    ),
  ),
  child: const Text('Success'),
)
```

### Error

```dart
CairnButton(
  variant: CairnButtonVariant.outline,
  size: CairnButtonSize.sm,
  onPressed: () => CairnToast.show(
    context,
    const CairnToast(
      variant: CairnToastVariant.error,
      title: 'Something went wrong',
      description: 'Your changes were not saved.',
    ),
  ),
  child: const Text('Error'),
)
```

### With action

```dart
CairnButton(
  variant: CairnButtonVariant.outline,
  size: CairnButtonSize.sm,
  onPressed: () => CairnToast.show(
    context,
    CairnToast(
      variant: CairnToastVariant.info,
      title: 'Update available',
      description: 'Version 0.2.0 is ready to install.',
      action: 'Install',
      onActionPressed: () {},
    ),
  ),
  child: const Text('With action'),
)
```

## API

### `CairnToast`

A transient notification.

A toast is `rounded-md border bg-popover p-4 text-popover-foreground
shadow-lg`, stacked bottom-right, sliding in from the edge and
auto-dismissing after four seconds — long enough to read a sentence, short
enough that a burst of them clears.

## Where the stack lives

Toasts must outlive the widget that triggered them — a toast fired from a
screen that then pops must still finish showing. [CairnToaster] therefore
owns an [OverlayEntry] on the root overlay, not a widget in the caller's
subtree, and [CairnToast.show] finds it through the [Overlay] rather than an
inherited widget.

**Constructor** `CairnToast({required String title, String? description, CairnToastVariant variant = CairnToastVariant.normal, Duration duration = const Duration(seconds: 4), String? action, VoidCallback? onActionPressed})`

Creates a toast description.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `String` | yes |  | The heading — `text-sm font-medium`. |
| `description` | `String?` |  |  | Optional supporting text — `text-sm text-muted-foreground`. |
| `variant` | `CairnToastVariant` |  | `CairnToastVariant.normal` | The severity. |
| `duration` | `Duration` |  | `const Duration(seconds: 4)` | How long before it dismisses itself. |
| `action` | `String?` |  |  | An optional action label. |
| `onActionPressed` | `VoidCallback?` |  |  | Called when the action is pressed. |

**Static members**

- `void show(BuildContext context, CairnToast toast)` — Shows this toast in the nearest root [Overlay]. Returns once the toast has been queued; it dismisses itself.

### `CairnToaster` (widget)

Hosts the toast stack.

Place once, above the rest of the app:

```dart
MaterialApp(
  builder: (context, child) => CairnToaster(child: child!),
  home: const HomeScreen(),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnToaster({required Widget child, Alignment alignment = Alignment.bottomRight, int maxVisible = 3, double width = 356.0})`

Creates a toast host.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | The app below the toast layer. |
| `alignment` | `Alignment` |  | `Alignment.bottomRight` | Where the stack sits. Sonner defaults to bottom-right. |
| `maxVisible` | `int` |  | `3` | How many toasts are shown at once before the oldest is dropped. |
| `width` | `double` |  | `356.0` | Sonner's toast width. |

### `CairnToastVariant` (enum)

The severity of a [CairnToast].

- `CairnToastVariant.normal` — A neutral message.
- `CairnToastVariant.success` — A success confirmation, with a check icon.
- `CairnToastVariant.error` — An error, styled with the destructive token.
- `CairnToastVariant.info` — An informational note.


---

# Data Table

Sorting, filtering and pagination on top of Table.

- Category: Data & feedback
- Widgets: `CairnDataTable`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Sorting copies the list instead of mutating the caller's, so the rows you passed in are never reordered behind your back.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnDataTable<Payment>(
  rows: payments,
  pageSize: 10,
  searchBy: (Payment p) => p.email,
  searchPlaceholder: 'Filter emails...',
  columns: <CairnColumn<Payment>>[
    CairnColumn<Payment>(
      label: 'Email',
      flex: 3,
      cell: (Payment p) => Text(p.email),
      sortKey: (Payment p) => p.email,
    ),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Payments

```dart
class Payment {
  const Payment(this.email, this.status, this.amount);
  final String email;
  final String status;
  final double amount;
}

CairnDataTable<Payment>(
  rows: payments,
  pageSize: 4,
  searchBy: (Payment p) => p.email,
  searchPlaceholder: 'Filter emails...',
  columns: <CairnColumn<Payment>>[
    CairnColumn<Payment>(
      label: 'Email',
      flex: 3,
      cell: (Payment p) => Text(p.email),
      sortKey: (Payment p) => p.email,
    ),
    CairnColumn<Payment>(
      label: 'Status',
      flex: 2,
      cell: (Payment p) => CairnBadge(
        variant: switch (p.status) {
          'Success' => CairnBadgeVariant.primary,
          'Failed' => CairnBadgeVariant.destructive,
          _ => CairnBadgeVariant.secondary,
        },
        label: Text(p.status),
      ),
      sortKey: (Payment p) => p.status,
    ),
    CairnColumn<Payment>(
      label: 'Amount',
      flex: 2,
      alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
      cell: (Payment p) => Text('\$${p.amount.toStringAsFixed(2)}'),
      sortKey: (Payment p) => p.amount,
    ),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnDataTable` (widget)

A sortable, filterable, paginated table built on [CairnTable].

This is behaviour layered onto [CairnTable], not a second rendering path:
sorting, filtering and pagination are added *above* the primitive rather
than reimplemented alongside it, so a plain table and a data table can never
drift apart visually.

Sorting is opt-in per column, enabled by giving a [CairnColumn] a `sortKey`.
Sortable headers become interactive and show a directional arrow.

```dart
CairnDataTable<Payment>(
  rows: payments,
  columns: [
    CairnColumn(
      label: 'Email',
      cell: (p) => Text(p.email),
      sortKey: (p) => p.email,
    ),
    CairnColumn(
      label: 'Amount',
      cell: (p) => Text(p.amount.toStringAsFixed(2)),
      sortKey: (p) => p.amount,
    ),
  ],
  searchBy: (p) => p.email,
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnDataTable({required List<CairnColumn<T>> columns, required List<T> rows, String Function(T row)? searchBy, String searchPlaceholder = 'Filter...', int? pageSize, void Function(int index, T row)? onRowTap, String emptyMessage = 'No results.'})`

Creates a data table.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `columns` | `List<CairnColumn<T>>` | yes |  | The columns. Any with a `sortKey` becomes sortable. |
| `rows` | `List<T>` | yes |  | The full row set, before filtering, sorting and pagination. |
| `searchBy` | `String Function(T row)?` |  |  | Extracts the text a row is matched against by the filter field. Null hides the filter field entirely. |
| `searchPlaceholder` | `String` |  | `'Filter...'` | The filter field's placeholder. |
| `pageSize` | `int?` |  |  | Rows per page. Null disables pagination. |
| `onRowTap` | `void Function(int index, T row)?` |  |  | Called when a row is tapped. |
| `emptyMessage` | `String` |  | `'No results.'` | Shown when no rows survive filtering. |

### `CairnSortDirection` (enum)

The sort direction of a [CairnDataTable] column.

- `CairnSortDirection.ascending` — Smallest first.
- `CairnSortDirection.descending` — Largest first.


---

# Calendar

A month grid on a fixed 7 x 6 layout.

- Category: Data & feedback
- Widgets: `CairnCalendar`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> The grid is always 7 x 6, so paging between months never changes the popover height — a jumping calendar is the classic giveaway.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnCalendar(
  selected: _date,
  firstDate: DateTime(2020),
  lastDate: DateTime(2030),
  weekStartsOnMonday: true,
  onChanged: (DateTime d) => setState(() => _date = d),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### September 2026

```dart
DateTime? _selected = DateTime(2026, 9, 11);

CairnCalendar(
  selected: _selected,
  initialMonth: DateTime(2026, 9),
  onChanged: (DateTime d) => setState(() => _selected = d),
)
```

## API

### `CairnCalendar` (widget)

A month-grid date picker.

Day cells are 32 logical pixel (`size-8`) ghost buttons. The selected day
takes the primary fill, today takes the accent fill, and days spilling in
from the neighbouring months are muted to 50% opacity so the current month
still reads as a single block.

The grid is a fixed 7 x 6 so the calendar's height never changes as months
with different day counts are paged through — a jumping popover is one of
the more obvious tells of a hand-rolled date picker.

```dart
CairnCalendar(
  selected: date,
  onChanged: (d) => setState(() => date = d),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnCalendar({DateTime? selected, ValueChanged<DateTime>? onChanged, DateTime? initialMonth, DateTime? firstDate, DateTime? lastDate, bool weekStartsOnMonday = true})`

Creates a calendar.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selected` | `DateTime?` |  |  | The currently selected day. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<DateTime>?` |  |  | Called when a day is chosen. |
| `initialMonth` | `DateTime?` |  |  | The month shown on first build. Defaults to [selected]'s month, else now. |
| `firstDate` | `DateTime?` |  |  | The earliest selectable day, inclusive. |
| `lastDate` | `DateTime?` |  |  | The latest selectable day, inclusive. |
| `weekStartsOnMonday` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether weeks start on Monday (ISO) rather than Sunday (US default). |

**Static members**

- `double cellSize = 32.0` — `size-8` — the day cell.


---

# Date Picker

A Calendar inside a Popover, behind a formatted trigger.

- Category: Data & feedback
- Widgets: `CairnDatePicker`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

## Quick start

```dart
CairnDatePicker(
  value: _date,
  placeholder: 'Pick a date',
  format: (DateTime d) => DateFormat.yMMMd().format(d),
  onChanged: (DateTime d) => setState(() => _date = d),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Pick a date

```dart
DateTime? _date;

CairnDatePicker(
  value: _date,
  onChanged: (DateTime d) => setState(() => _date = d),
)
```

## API

### `CairnDatePicker` (widget)

A date field: a Calendar in a Popover, behind a button-shaped trigger.

A date picker is a composition rather than a primitive: an outline Button
trigger whose label is either the formatted date or a muted placeholder,
opening a Popover that holds a Calendar. Cairn ships it pre-assembled so it
is one widget at the call site, while still being built from
[CairnCalendar] and the popover layer — nothing here is a private
re-implementation of either.

[format] defaults to an unambiguous `D Month YYYY`. Applications with
`intl` available should pass their own formatter rather than relying on it,
which is why this takes a callback instead of a pattern string — the package
stays dependency-free.

```dart
CairnDatePicker(
  value: date,
  onChanged: (d) => setState(() => date = d),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnDatePicker({DateTime? value, ValueChanged<DateTime>? onChanged, String placeholder = 'Pick a date', String Function(DateTime)? format, DateTime? firstDate, DateTime? lastDate, DateTime? initialMonth, double width = 240.0, bool hasError = false})`

Creates a date picker.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `DateTime?` |  |  | The selected date. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<DateTime>?` |  |  | Called when a date is chosen. |
| `placeholder` | `String` |  | `'Pick a date'` | Text shown when nothing is selected. |
| `format` | `String Function(DateTime)?` |  |  | Formats the selected date for display. |
| `firstDate` | `DateTime?` |  |  | The earliest selectable date. |
| `lastDate` | `DateTime?` |  |  | The latest selectable date. |
| `initialMonth` | `DateTime?` |  |  | The month the calendar opens on when nothing is selected. Defaults to the current month. Set this to make the picker deterministic in tests, or to open on a business-relevant month. |
| `width` | `double` |  | `240.0` | The trigger width. |
| `hasError` | `bool` |  | `false` | Marks the field invalid. |


---

# Rating

A star rating with half steps and keyboard control.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnRating`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> A null onChanged makes it read-only. Arrow keys, Home and End step the value.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnRating(
  value: _rating,
  allowHalf: true,
  onChanged: (double v) => setState(() => _rating = v),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Interactive · half steps

```dart
CairnRating(
  value: _rating,
  allowHalf: true,
  onChanged: (double v) => setState(() => _rating = v),
)
```

### Read-only

```dart
const CairnRating(value: 4.5)
```

## API

### `CairnRating` (widget)

A star rating input and display.

A row of 20px stars with a 2px gap. Filled stars take the [tone] colour
(amber by default, the conventional star colour) and empty ones the
`border` token's stroke. With [onChanged] null the rating is read-only —
no hover, no focus, no cursor change — which is the right default for
showing an aggregate score.

Fractional [value]s (a 3.5 average) paint a half star. The input itself
only produces whole values, or halves when [allowHalf] is set.

Keyboard: arrow keys step the value by one (or a half), Home and End jump
to zero and [count].

```dart
CairnRating(value: _stars, onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _stars = v));
```

**Constructor** `CairnRating({required double value, ValueChanged<double>? onChanged, int count = 5, double size = 20.0, bool allowHalf = false, CairnTone tone = CairnTone.warning, String semanticLabel = 'Rating'})`

Creates a rating.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `double` | yes |  | The current rating, from 0 to [count]. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<double>?` |  |  | Called with the new rating. Null makes the rating read-only. |
| `count` | `int` |  | `5` | How many stars. |
| `size` | `double` |  | `20.0` | The star size. |
| `allowHalf` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether the input can produce half-star values. |
| `tone` | `CairnTone` |  | `CairnTone.warning` | The filled-star colour. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String` |  | `'Rating'` | The accessible name. |


---

# Swap

A controlled two-face toggle with fade, rotate and flip.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnSwap`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

## Quick start

```dart
CairnSwap(
  effect: CairnSwapEffect.rotate,
  value: _on,
  onChanged: (bool v) => setState(() => _on = v),
  on: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.check),
  off: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.plus),
)
```

## API

### `CairnSwap` (widget)

A toggle that swaps between two widgets — a hamburger and a close icon, a
sun and a moon, a play and a pause.

Tapping (or pressing Space / Enter when focused) calls [onChanged] with the
opposite of [value]. The control is controlled: it shows [on] when [value] is
true and [off] otherwise, and animates between them at 200ms on the standard
curve using the chosen [effect].

```dart
CairnSwap(
  value: _open,
  onChanged: (v) => setState(() => _open = v),
  effect: CairnSwapEffect.rotate,
  on: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.close),
  off: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.moreHorizontal),
  semanticLabel: 'Toggle menu',
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnSwap({required bool value, required Widget on, required Widget off, ValueChanged<bool>? onChanged, CairnSwapEffect effect = CairnSwapEffect.fade, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a swap.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `bool` | yes |  | Whether [on] is showing. |
| `on` | `Widget` | yes |  | The face shown when [value] is true. |
| `off` | `Widget` | yes |  | The face shown when [value] is false. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<bool>?` |  |  | Called with the new value on tap. Null makes the swap inert. |
| `effect` | `CairnSwapEffect` |  | `CairnSwapEffect.fade` | The transition style. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. |

### `CairnSwapEffect` (enum)

How a [CairnSwap] animates between its two faces.

- `CairnSwapEffect.fade` — Cross-fade.
- `CairnSwapEffect.rotate` — Rotate a quarter turn while fading — a menu icon becoming a close icon.
- `CairnSwapEffect.flip` — Flip around the vertical axis.


---

# File Input

A file field that draws the control and leaves picking to you.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnFileInput`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Cairn takes no dependencies, so wire onBrowse to file_picker or a web input.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnFileInput(
  fileName: _file,
  onBrowse: _pickFile,
  onClear: () => setState(() => _file = null),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Browse and clear

```dart
CairnFileInput(
  fileName: _file,
  onBrowse: () => setState(() => _file = 'quarterly-report.pdf'),
  onClear: () => setState(() => _file = null),
)
```

### Invalid

```dart
CairnFileInput(invalid: true, onBrowse: () {})
```

## API

### `CairnFileInput` (widget)

A file picker control with the same footprint as [CairnInput].

`h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input px-3 text-sm shadow-xs` with a
"Choose file" segment on the left and the selected [fileName] (or the
[placeholder]) beside it, so it lines up in a form column with every other
field.

Cairn deliberately has no dependencies, so this widget draws the control but
does not open a system picker: [onBrowse] is where you call
`file_picker`, `image_picker` or a web `<input type=file>`. Report the choice
back by setting [fileName]; pass [onClear] to show a clear button once a
file is selected.

```dart
CairnFileInput(
  fileName: _picked?.name,
  onBrowse: () async => _picked = await pickFile(),
  onClear: () => setState(() => _picked = null),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnFileInput({String? fileName, VoidCallback? onBrowse, VoidCallback? onClear, String placeholder = 'No file chosen', String buttonLabel = 'Choose file', bool invalid = false, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a file input.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fileName` | `String?` |  |  | The chosen file's name, or null when nothing is chosen. |
| `onBrowse` | `VoidCallback?` |  |  | Called to open the picker. Null disables the control. |
| `onClear` | `VoidCallback?` |  |  | Called to clear the selection. The clear button only shows when this is non-null and a file is chosen. |
| `placeholder` | `String` |  | `'No file chosen'` | Shown when [fileName] is null. |
| `buttonLabel` | `String` |  | `'Choose file'` | The label on the left-hand segment. |
| `invalid` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to draw the destructive outline. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. |


---

# Floating Action Button

A round action button that can open into a speed dial.

- Category: Forms
- Widgets: `CairnFab`, `CairnFabAction`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Non-empty actions turn it into a speed dial. Position it yourself with Align or Positioned.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnFab(
  icon: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.plus),
  semanticLabel: 'Create',
  actions: <CairnFabAction>[
    CairnFabAction(
      icon: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.search),
      label: 'Document',
      onPressed: _newDocument,
    ),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Single action

```dart
CairnFab(
  icon: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.plus),
  semanticLabel: 'Create',
  onPressed: () {},
)
```

### Speed dial

```dart
CairnFab(
  icon: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.plus),
  semanticLabel: 'Create',
  actions: <CairnFabAction>[
    CairnFabAction(
      icon: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.search),
      label: 'Document',
      onPressed: () {},
    ),
    CairnFabAction(
      icon: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.info),
      label: 'Folder',
      onPressed: () {},
    ),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnFab` (widget)

A floating action button, optionally expanding into a speed dial.

A 56px primary-coloured circle with the large shadow, the standard
treatment for a screen's one primary action. Without [actions] it is a plain
button calling [onPressed]. With [actions] it toggles a stack of labelled
40px mini actions above it; the trigger rotates 45 degrees (so a plus
becomes a cross) and closes again after an action is picked.

Place it with `Positioned` or `Align` — it takes only its own size and
leaves placement to the caller, as Cairn's other overlays do.

```dart
CairnFab(
  icon: const CairnIcon(CairnIconData.plus),
  semanticLabel: 'Create',
  actions: [
    CairnFabAction(icon: Icon(...), label: 'Document', onPressed: () {}),
  ],
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnFab({required Widget icon, VoidCallback? onPressed, List<CairnFabAction> actions = const <CairnFabAction>[], String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a floating action button.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `Widget` | yes |  | The trigger glyph. Draw it as a plus if you use [actions], so the open rotation reads as a close. |
| `onPressed` | `VoidCallback?` |  |  | Called on tap when there are no [actions]. |
| `actions` | `List<CairnFabAction>` |  | `const <CairnFabAction>[]` | Speed-dial entries, nearest the trigger first. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name of the trigger. |

### `CairnFabAction`

One entry of a [CairnFab] speed dial.

**Constructor** `CairnFabAction({required Widget icon, required String label, required VoidCallback onPressed})`

Creates an action.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `Widget` | yes |  | The glyph. |
| `label` | `String` | yes |  | The label shown beside the mini button, also its accessible name. |
| `onPressed` | `VoidCallback` | yes |  | Called when picked. The dial closes afterwards. |


---

# Stat

A figure with its label and context, grouped by Stats.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnStat`, `CairnStats`, `CairnStats`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> CairnStats joins its children with 1px dividers inside one bordered card.

## Quick start

```dart
const CairnStats(
  children: <Widget>[
    CairnStat(
      title: Text('Active users'),
      value: Text('4,200'),
      description: Text('+180 this week'),
    ),
    CairnStat(title: Text('Error rate'), value: Text('0.4%')),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Stats group

```dart
const CairnStats(
  children: <Widget>[
    CairnStat(
      title: Text('Total revenue'),
      value: Text(r'$31,200'),
      description: Text('+12% from last month'),
    ),
    CairnStat(
      title: Text('Active users'),
      value: Text('4,200'),
      description: Text('+180 this week'),
    ),
    CairnStat(
      title: Text('Error rate'),
      value: Text('0.4%'),
      description: Text('Within budget'),
    ),
  ],
)
```

### Single stat

```dart
const CairnStat(
  title: Text('Active users'),
  value: Text('4,200'),
  description: Text('+180 this week'),
)
```

## API

### `CairnStat` (widget)

A single headline figure with its label and context.

A [title] in muted small text, a [value] in 30px semibold with tight
tracking, and a [description] in muted extra-small text — the same type
roles a Card uses, stacked at a 4px rhythm. An optional [figure] (an icon or
avatar) sits at the trailing edge, and [actions] below the description.

Put several in a [CairnStats] to get the divided row.

```dart
const CairnStat(
  title: Text('Total revenue'),
  value: Text('\$31,200'),
  description: Text('+12% from last month'),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnStat({required Widget title, required Widget value, Widget? description, Widget? figure, Widget? actions})`

Creates a stat.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Widget` | yes |  | The label above the figure. |
| `value` | `Widget` | yes |  | The headline figure. |
| `description` | `Widget?` |  |  | A line of context beneath the figure. |
| `figure` | `Widget?` |  |  | A trailing icon or avatar. |
| `actions` | `Widget?` |  |  | Controls shown under the description. |

### `CairnStats` (widget)

A bordered, divided row (or column) of [CairnStat]s.

`rounded-xl border` with a 1px [CairnTheme.border] hairline between
children, so it reads as one object — the same container treatment as a
Card, minus the shadow.

**Constructor** `CairnStats({required List<Widget> children, Axis direction = Axis.horizontal})`

Creates a stat group.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | yes |  | The stats. |
| `direction` | `Axis` |  | `Axis.horizontal` | Whether stats sit side by side or stacked. |


---

# Status

A small tone dot, optionally pulsing.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnStatus`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Tones are the CairnTone token: success, warning and info join primary and destructive.

## Quick start

```dart
const CairnStatus(
  tone: CairnTone.success,
  ping: true,
  semanticLabel: 'Online',
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Neutral

```dart
const CairnStatus(tone: CairnTone.neutral)
```

### Success · ping

```dart
const CairnStatus(tone: CairnTone.success, ping: true)
```

### Warning

```dart
const CairnStatus(tone: CairnTone.warning)
```

### Info

```dart
const CairnStatus(tone: CairnTone.info)
```

### Destructive

```dart
const CairnStatus(tone: CairnTone.destructive)
```

## API

### `CairnStatus` (widget)

A small dot communicating state — online, away, failing.

An 8 logical pixel circle in a [CairnTone] colour with a 1px halo of the
same colour at 30% alpha so it stays legible against any surface. Set
[ping] to pulse a ring outwards, for state that is live right now.

```dart
const CairnStatus(tone: CairnTone.success, semanticLabel: 'Online');
```

**Constructor** `CairnStatus({CairnTone tone = CairnTone.neutral, double size = 8.0, bool ping = false, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a status dot.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `CairnTone` |  | `CairnTone.neutral` | The colour intent. |
| `size` | `double` |  | `8.0` | The dot diameter. |
| `ping` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to pulse a ring outwards from the dot. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. A dot is meaningless to a screen reader without one. |


---

# Timeline

Events on a marker rail with a connecting hairline.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnTimeline`, `CairnTimelineItem`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

## Quick start

```dart
const CairnTimeline(
  items: <CairnTimelineItem>[
    CairnTimelineItem(
      tone: CairnTone.success,
      title: Text('Deployed to production'),
      time: Text('2m ago'),
    ),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Release history

```dart
const CairnTimeline(
  items: <CairnTimelineItem>[
    CairnTimelineItem(
      tone: CairnTone.success,
      icon: CairnIcon(CairnIconData.check),
      title: Text('Deployed to production'),
      description: Text('Build 482 passed all checks.'),
      time: Text('2m ago'),
    ),
    CairnTimelineItem(
      tone: CairnTone.info,
      title: Text('Review approved'),
      time: Text('1h ago'),
    ),
    CairnTimelineItem(
      title: Text('Pull request opened'),
      description: Text('Add the extended components.'),
      time: Text('Yesterday'),
    ),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnTimelineItem`

One event on a [CairnTimeline].

**Constructor** `CairnTimelineItem({required Widget title, Widget? description, Widget? time, Widget? icon, CairnTone tone = CairnTone.neutral})`

Creates a timeline event.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Widget` | yes |  | What happened. |
| `description` | `Widget?` |  |  | Detail beneath the title. |
| `time` | `Widget?` |  |  | When it happened — rendered in muted text beside the title. |
| `icon` | `Widget?` |  |  | A glyph inside the marker. Without one the marker is a plain dot. |
| `tone` | `CairnTone` |  | `CairnTone.neutral` | The marker colour. |

### `CairnTimeline` (widget)

A vertical sequence of events joined by a line.

Each event has a marker on a shared left rail with a 1px [CairnTheme.border]
line running through to the next. A marker with an [CairnTimelineItem.icon]
is a 24px filled circle; without one it is an 8px dot centred on the same
rail, so mixed timelines stay aligned.

```dart
const CairnTimeline(items: [
  CairnTimelineItem(
    tone: CairnTone.success,
    title: Text('Deployed'),
    time: Text('2m ago'),
  ),
]);
```

**Constructor** `CairnTimeline({required List<CairnTimelineItem> items})`

Creates a timeline.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CairnTimelineItem>` | yes |  | The events, top to bottom. |


---

# Chat Bubble

A message bubble that aligns itself by sender.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnChatBubble`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Capped at 75% of its parent's width.

## Quick start

```dart
const CairnChatBubble(
  side: CairnChatSide.sent,
  footer: Text('Delivered'),
  child: Text('Shipped.'),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Received

```dart
const CairnChatBubble(
  author: Text('Ada'),
  footer: Text('10:02'),
  child: Text('Did the release go out?'),
)
```

### Sent

```dart
const CairnChatBubble(
  side: CairnChatSide.sent,
  footer: Text('Delivered'),
  child: Text('Shipped. Watching the dashboards now.'),
)
```

## API

### `CairnChatBubble` (widget)

A message bubble.

`rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm` capped at 75% of the available width. The
corner nearest the sender is squared off to a small radius so the bubble
reads as speaking from that side. [CairnChatSide.sent] uses the `primary`
slot and [CairnChatSide.received] the `secondary` slot, so a chat re-themes
with everything else.

Compose a conversation by stacking bubbles in a [Column]; the bubble aligns
itself within its parent.

```dart
const CairnChatBubble(
  side: CairnChatSide.sent,
  author: Text('You'),
  footer: Text('Delivered'),
  child: Text('Shipped!'),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnChatBubble({required Widget child, CairnChatSide side = CairnChatSide.received, Widget? avatar, Widget? author, Widget? footer})`

Creates a chat bubble.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | The message content. |
| `side` | `CairnChatSide` |  | `CairnChatSide.received` | Which side the bubble speaks from. |
| `avatar` | `Widget?` |  |  | A leading (received) or trailing (sent) avatar, usually a [CairnAvatar]. |
| `author` | `Widget?` |  |  | A small name line above the bubble. |
| `footer` | `Widget?` |  |  | A small line below the bubble — a timestamp or delivery state. |

### `CairnChatSide` (enum)

Which side of the conversation a [CairnChatBubble] belongs to.

- `CairnChatSide.received` — The other party — left-aligned, on a `secondary` fill.
- `CairnChatSide.sent` — The current user — right-aligned, on a `primary` fill.


---

# Indicator

A badge or dot pinned to a corner of its child.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnIndicator`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> The indicator is positioned over the child and does not affect layout.

## Quick start

```dart
const CairnIndicator(
  indicator: CairnBadge(label: Text('3')),
  child: CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('RB')),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Badge

```dart
const CairnIndicator(
  indicator: CairnBadge(label: Text('3')),
  child: CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('RB')),
)
```

### Status dot

```dart
const CairnIndicator(
  placement: CairnIndicatorPlacement.bottomEnd,
  offset: Offset(-4, -4),
  indicator: CairnStatus(tone: CairnTone.success, size: 10),
  child: CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('AL')),
)
```

## API

### `CairnIndicator` (widget)

Pins a small badge to a corner of [child] — an unread count on an icon, a
status dot on an avatar.

The [indicator] is centred on the corner of the child's box, so it straddles
the edge rather than sitting inside it. It does not take part in layout: the
indicator can overflow the child without changing the child's size, which is
what you want when the child is already positioned in a row.

Use a [CairnBadge] or [CairnStatus] as the indicator — both are sized for
this.

```dart
CairnIndicator(
  indicator: const CairnBadge(label: Text('3')),
  child: const CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('RB')),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnIndicator({required Widget child, required Widget indicator, CairnIndicatorPlacement placement = CairnIndicatorPlacement.topEnd, Offset offset = Offset.zero})`

Creates an indicator.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | The widget being annotated. |
| `indicator` | `Widget` | yes |  | The badge. |
| `placement` | `CairnIndicatorPlacement` |  | `CairnIndicatorPlacement.topEnd` | Which corner. |
| `offset` | `Offset` |  | `Offset.zero` | A nudge applied after placement, for example to tuck a dot inside the edge of a circular avatar. |

### `CairnIndicatorPlacement` (enum)

Where a [CairnIndicator]'s badge sits on its child.

- `CairnIndicatorPlacement.topStart` — Top-left corner.
- `CairnIndicatorPlacement.topEnd` — Top-right corner.
- `CairnIndicatorPlacement.bottomStart` — Bottom-left corner.
- `CairnIndicatorPlacement.bottomEnd` — Bottom-right corner.


---

# Stack

Overlapping layers, or an avatar pile.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnStack`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

## Quick start

```dart
CairnStack(
  offset: 8,
  children: <Widget>[
    CairnCard(children: <Widget>[CairnCardHeader(title: Text('Top'))]),
    CairnCard(children: <Widget>[CairnCardHeader(title: Text('Behind'))]),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Cards

```dart
CairnStack(
  children: <Widget>[
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
      CairnCard(
        children: <Widget>[CairnCardHeader(title: Text('Card ${i + 1}'))],
      ),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnStack` (widget)

Overlaps its children like a pile of cards.

The first child is on top. Each following child is shifted by [offset] and
shrunk slightly, with a hairline [CairnTheme.border] edge so the layers stay
distinguishable on a matching surface. Pass the same-sized children — the
stack takes the size of the first (top) one.

Also the right tool for an avatar pile: set [offset] to a small negative
horizontal value and let [reverse] put the first avatar on top.

```dart
CairnStack(
  offset: const Offset(0, 8),
  children: [CairnCard(...), CairnCard(...), CairnCard(...)],
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnStack({required List<Widget> children, Offset offset = const Offset(0, 8), double scaleStep = 0.05})`

Creates a stack.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | yes |  | The layers, top first. |
| `offset` | `Offset` |  | `const Offset(0, 8)` | How far each layer moves from the one above it. |
| `scaleStep` | `double` |  | `0.05` | How much each layer shrinks, as a fraction of its size. |


---

# Hero

A landing-page header with eyebrow, actions and a 36rem measure.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnHero`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

## Quick start

```dart
CairnHero(
  eyebrow: const CairnBadge(label: Text('New')),
  title: const Text('Build interfaces that hold together'),
  description: const Text('Tokens first, widgets second.'),
  actions: <Widget>[
    CairnButton(onPressed: _start, child: const Text('Get started')),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Muted

```dart
CairnHero(
  muted: true,
  eyebrow: const CairnBadge(label: Text('New')),
  title: const Text('Build interfaces that hold together'),
  description: const Text(
    'Tokens first, widgets second — so a theme change is one edit, not a hunt.',
  ),
  actions: <Widget>[
    CairnButton(onPressed: () {}, child: const Text('Get started')),
    CairnButton(
      variant: CairnButtonVariant.outline,
      onPressed: () {},
      child: const Text('Browse components'),
    ),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnHero` (widget)

A landing-page header block: headline, supporting copy and actions.

A centred column — [title] in 36px semibold with tight tracking (`text-4xl
font-semibold tracking-tight`), [description] in 18px muted text capped at
36rem for a comfortable measure, and [actions] in a wrapping row beneath. An
[eyebrow] (a [CairnBadge], typically) sits above the headline.

By default the hero is transparent so it inherits the page surface. Pass
[muted] for a `muted` filled band, or [background] for any other widget
(an image, a gradient) painted behind the content.

```dart
CairnHero(
  eyebrow: CairnBadge(label: Text('New')),
  title: Text('Build faster'),
  description: Text('Everything you need to ship.'),
  actions: [CairnButton(onPressed: () {}, child: Text('Get started'))],
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnHero({required Widget title, Widget? description, Widget? eyebrow, List<Widget> actions = const <Widget>[], CrossAxisAlignment alignment = CrossAxisAlignment.center, bool muted = false, Widget? background, EdgeInsetsGeometry padding = const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: CairnSpacing.s6, vertical: CairnSpacing.s20)})`

Creates a hero.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Widget` | yes |  | The headline. |
| `description` | `Widget?` |  |  | Supporting copy. |
| `eyebrow` | `Widget?` |  |  | A small element above the headline. |
| `actions` | `List<Widget>` |  | `const <Widget>[]` | Calls to action. |
| `alignment` | `CrossAxisAlignment` |  | `CrossAxisAlignment.center` | Horizontal alignment of the content. |
| `muted` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to fill the band with the `muted` token. |
| `background` | `Widget?` |  |  | A widget painted behind the content. |
| `padding` | `EdgeInsetsGeometry` |  | `const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: CairnSpacing.s6, vertical: CairnSpacing.s20)` | Space around the content. |


---

# Diff

A draggable before-and-after comparison.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnDiff`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Drag the grip, or focus it and use the arrow keys, Home and End.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnDiff(
  aspectRatio: 16 / 9,
  before: Image.asset('before.png', fit: BoxFit.cover),
  after: Image.asset('after.png', fit: BoxFit.cover),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Draggable divider

```dart
CairnDiff(
  aspectRatio: 16 / 9,
  before: ColoredBox(
    color: theme.muted,
    child: Center(
      child: Text('Before', style: TextStyle(color: theme.mutedForeground)),
    ),
  ),
  after: ColoredBox(
    color: theme.primary,
    child: Center(
      child: Text('After', style: TextStyle(color: theme.primaryForeground)),
    ),
  ),
)
```

## API

### `CairnDiff` (widget)

A before/after comparison with a draggable divider.

Two widgets are stacked at the same size; [after] is clipped to the right of
a divider that the user drags (or moves with the arrow keys) to reveal more
of [before] or [after]. Useful for image edits, design reviews and theme
comparisons.

The divider is a 1px [CairnTheme.border]-strength line carrying a 32px round
grip with chevrons, and has a 44px-wide hit area so it stays easy to catch
on touch. The comparison fills the width it is given; give it an
[aspectRatio] (or wrap it in a sized box) to fix the height.

```dart
CairnDiff(
  aspectRatio: 16 / 9,
  before: Image.asset('before.png', fit: BoxFit.cover),
  after: Image.asset('after.png', fit: BoxFit.cover),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnDiff({required Widget before, required Widget after, double initialPosition = 0.5, double? aspectRatio, ValueChanged<double>? onChanged, String semanticLabel = 'Comparison divider'})`

Creates a diff.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `before` | `Widget` | yes |  | Shown on the left of the divider. |
| `after` | `Widget` | yes |  | Shown on the right of the divider. |
| `initialPosition` | `double` |  | `0.5` | The divider's starting position as a fraction of the width. |
| `aspectRatio` | `double?` |  |  | Fixes the height as width / ratio. Null lets the parent decide. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<double>?` |  |  | Called as the divider moves. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String` |  | `'Comparison divider'` | The accessible name of the divider. |


---

# List

Rows with leading, trailing and selected states.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnList`, `CairnListItem`, `CairnListItem`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

## Quick start

```dart
CairnList(
  bordered: true,
  children: <Widget>[
    CairnListItem(
      leading: const CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('RB')),
      title: const Text('Ralph'),
      subtitle: const Text('Owner'),
      onTap: _open,
    ),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Bordered

```dart
CairnList(
  bordered: true,
  children: <Widget>[
    CairnListItem(
      leading: const CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('RB')),
      title: const Text('Ralph'),
      subtitle: const Text('Owner'),
      trailing: const CairnBadge(label: Text('Admin')),
      onTap: () {},
    ),
    CairnListItem(
      leading: const CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('AL')),
      title: const Text('Ada'),
      subtitle: const Text('Maintainer'),
      trailing: const CairnBadge(
        variant: CairnBadgeVariant.secondary,
        label: Text('Member'),
      ),
      onTap: () {},
    ),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnList` (widget)

A vertical list of rows — contacts, files, settings, a playlist.

Rows are separated by a 1px [CairnTheme.border] hairline (no hairline after
the last), and the list itself is unbordered so it can sit inside a Card or
directly on the page. Set [bordered] to wrap it in the Card-style container.

Use [CairnListItem] for the usual leading / title / subtitle / trailing
shape, or put any widget in [children].

```dart
CairnList(children: [
  CairnListItem(
    leading: CairnAvatar(fallback: Text('RB')),
    title: Text('Ralph'),
    subtitle: Text('Owner'),
    trailing: CairnBadge(label: Text('Admin')),
    onTap: () {},
  ),
]);
```

**Constructor** `CairnList({required List<Widget> children, bool bordered = false})`

Creates a list.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `List<Widget>` | yes |  | The rows. |
| `bordered` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to wrap the list in a `rounded-xl border` container. |

### `CairnListItem` (widget)

A row in a [CairnList].

`px-4 py-3`, a 12px gap between slots, and a [title] in 14px medium over a
[subtitle] in 12px muted. When [onTap] is set the row hovers to the `accent`
fill and takes focus like any other Cairn control; without it the row is
static.

**Constructor** `CairnListItem({required Widget title, Widget? subtitle, Widget? leading, Widget? trailing, VoidCallback? onTap, bool selected = false})`

Creates a list row.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Widget` | yes |  | The primary line. |
| `subtitle` | `Widget?` |  |  | The secondary line. |
| `leading` | `Widget?` |  |  | A leading avatar or icon. |
| `trailing` | `Widget?` |  |  | A trailing badge, button or value. |
| `onTap` | `VoidCallback?` |  |  | Makes the row tappable. |
| `selected` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to fill the row with `accent`, for a current selection. |


---

# Mockup

Window, browser, code and phone frames for showcasing content.

- Category: Display
- Widgets: `CairnMockupWindow`, `CairnMockupBrowser`, `CairnMockupCode`, `CairnMockupPhone`, `CairnMockupWindow`, `CairnMockupBrowser`, `CairnMockupCode`, `CairnMockupPhone`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

## Quick start

```dart
const CairnMockupBrowser(
  url: 'https://cairn.dev',
  child: SizedBox(height: 96),
)

const CairnMockupCode(
  lines: <String>['flutter pub add cairn_ui'],
  highlight: <int>{0},
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Browser

```dart
CairnMockupBrowser(
  url: 'https://cairn.dev',
  child: SizedBox(height: 96),
)
```

### Window

```dart
CairnMockupWindow(
  title: Text('Terminal'),
  child: SizedBox(height: 56),
)
```

### Code

```dart
CairnMockupCode(
  lines: <String>['flutter pub add cairn_ui', 'flutter run'],
  highlight: <int>{0},
)
```

### Phone

```dart
CairnMockupPhone(
  width: 200,
  child: Center(child: Text('Your app')),
)
```

## API

### `CairnMockupWindow` (widget)

A window frame with three title-bar dots — the base for the other mockups.

`rounded-xl border` with a 40px title bar on a `muted` fill, three 10px
dots (drawn in neutral grey rather than the macOS red/amber/green, so the
frame sits in the theme instead of fighting it) and an optional [title]
centred in the bar. [child] fills the body on the `card` surface.

```dart
const CairnMockupWindow(
  title: Text('Untitled'),
  child: Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.all(16), child: Text('Hello')),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnMockupWindow({required Widget child, Widget? title})`

Creates a window mockup.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | The window body. |
| `title` | `Widget?` |  |  | Text in the title bar. |

### `CairnMockupBrowser` (widget)

A browser frame: window dots plus a pill-shaped address bar.

[url] is shown in the address bar in muted small text. [child] is the
"page" beneath it.

```dart
const CairnMockupBrowser(
  url: 'https://cairn.dev',
  child: SizedBox(height: 160),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnMockupBrowser({required Widget child, String? url})`

Creates a browser mockup.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | The page content. |
| `url` | `String?` |  |  | The address shown in the bar. |

### `CairnMockupCode` (widget)

A terminal-style code block.

Each of [lines] is drawn on its own row with a muted [prefix] gutter
(`$` by default) in the theme's foreground on a `muted` fill, in a
fixed-pitch face. Lines in [highlight] take the `accent` fill and full
foreground colour — for pointing at the line that matters.

This is a mockup, not a syntax highlighter; it displays text as given.

```dart
const CairnMockupCode(lines: ['flutter pub add cairn_ui', 'flutter run']);
```

**Constructor** `CairnMockupCode({required List<String> lines, String prefix = r'$', Set<int> highlight = const <int>{}})`

Creates a code mockup.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lines` | `List<String>` | yes |  | The code, one entry per line. |
| `prefix` | `String` |  | `r'$'` | The gutter marker, repeated on every line. |
| `highlight` | `Set<int>` |  | `const <int>{}` | Zero-based indexes of lines to emphasise. |

### `CairnMockupPhone` (widget)

A phone frame: a thick rounded bezel with a notch.

A 280px-wide device (override with [width]) at a 9:19.5 aspect ratio with a
10px bezel in the `foreground` colour, a 36px-radius outer corner, and a
small pill notch. [child] fills the screen, clipped to its inner radius.

```dart
const CairnMockupPhone(child: Center(child: Text('Hello')));
```

**Constructor** `CairnMockupPhone({required Widget child, double width = 280.0})`

Creates a phone mockup.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | The screen content. |
| `width` | `double` |  | `280.0` | The device width. |

# Steps

A progress rail for multi-step flows.

- Category: Navigation
- Widgets: `CairnSteps`, `CairnStep`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Only completed steps are tappable.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnSteps(
  current: 1,
  onStepTap: (int i) => setState(() => _step = i),
  steps: const <CairnStep>[
    CairnStep(label: 'Cart'),
    CairnStep(label: 'Shipping'),
    CairnStep(label: 'Done'),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Horizontal

```dart
const CairnSteps(
  current: 1,
  steps: <CairnStep>[
    CairnStep(label: 'Cart', description: 'Review items'),
    CairnStep(label: 'Shipping', description: 'Where to?'),
    CairnStep(label: 'Payment', description: 'Pay securely'),
    CairnStep(label: 'Done'),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnStep`

One step of a [CairnSteps] indicator.

**Constructor** `CairnStep({required String label, String? description, Widget? marker})`

Creates a step.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `String` | yes |  | The step's name. |
| `description` | `String?` |  |  | An optional second line. |
| `marker` | `Widget?` |  |  | Replaces the step number inside the circle — an icon or an emoji. |

### `CairnSteps` (widget)

A progress-through-a-process indicator — checkout, onboarding, a wizard.

A row (or column) of 28px circles joined by a 2px line. Steps before
[current] are complete (filled, with a check), [current] is filled and
numbered, and later steps are outlined and muted. The connecting line fills
in as the index advances, animated at 300ms on the standard curve like
[CairnProgress].

Set [tone] to tint the completed portion, for example
[CairnTone.success].

```dart
const CairnSteps(
  current: 1,
  steps: [
    CairnStep(label: 'Cart'),
    CairnStep(label: 'Shipping'),
    CairnStep(label: 'Payment'),
  ],
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnSteps({required List<CairnStep> steps, int current = 0, Axis direction = Axis.horizontal, CairnTone tone = CairnTone.primary, ValueChanged<int>? onStepTap})`

Creates a steps indicator.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | `List<CairnStep>` | yes |  | The steps, in order. |
| `current` | `int` |  | `0` | The zero-based index of the active step. A value past the last step marks every step complete. |
| `direction` | `Axis` |  | `Axis.horizontal` | Whether the steps run across or down. |
| `tone` | `CairnTone` |  | `CairnTone.primary` | The colour of completed and current steps. |
| `onStepTap` | `ValueChanged<int>?` |  |  | Called with a step's index when a *completed* step is tapped, so a wizard can navigate back. Later steps are not tappable. |

# Navbar

A top bar with start, centre and end slots.

- Category: Navigation
- Widgets: `CairnNavbar`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> The centre slot is centred on the bar itself, not on the space left over.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnNavbar(
  start: const Text('Cairn'),
  end: CairnButton(
    size: CairnButtonSize.sm,
    onPressed: _signIn,
    child: const Text('Sign in'),
  ),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Start, centre and end

```dart
CairnNavbar(
  start: const Text('Cairn'),
  center: const CairnBadge(
    variant: CairnBadgeVariant.secondary,
    label: Text('v0.2'),
  ),
  end: CairnButton(
    size: CairnButtonSize.sm,
    onPressed: () {},
    child: const Text('Sign in'),
  ),
)
```

## API

### `CairnNavbar` (widget)

A top application bar with start, centre and end regions.

A 56px bar on the `background` surface with a 1px bottom [CairnTheme.border]
hairline and 16px side padding — the shell most apps put a logo, primary
navigation and an account menu into. Regions are optional: with only
[start] and [end] the bar justifies them to the edges; a [center] is truly
centred on the bar, not merely between its neighbours, so a logo does not
drift when the two sides have different widths.

Wrap with `SafeArea` yourself on mobile; the navbar draws only its own box.

```dart
CairnNavbar(
  start: Text('Cairn'),
  center: CairnTabs(...),
  end: CairnAvatar(...),
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnNavbar({Widget? start, Widget? center, Widget? end, double height = 56.0, bool bordered = true, Color? color})`

Creates a navbar.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | `Widget?` |  |  | Leading content — logo, back button, menu toggle. |
| `center` | `Widget?` |  |  | Centred content. |
| `end` | `Widget?` |  |  | Trailing content — actions, account menu. |
| `height` | `double` |  | `56.0` | The bar height (`h-14`). |
| `bordered` | `bool` |  | `true` | Whether to draw the bottom hairline. |
| `color` | `Color?` |  |  | Overrides the `background` fill — for example `theme.card` for a raised bar. |


---

# Dock

A 64px bottom navigation bar for mobile.

- Category: Navigation
- Widgets: `CairnDock`, `CairnDockItem`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Needs at least two items.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnDock(
  index: _tab,
  onChanged: (int i) => setState(() => _tab = i),
  items: const <CairnDockItem>[
    CairnDockItem(icon: CairnIcon(CairnIconData.search), label: 'Search'),
    CairnDockItem(icon: CairnIcon(CairnIconData.info), label: 'Inbox'),
  ],
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Three items · badge

```dart
CairnDock(
  index: _tab,
  onChanged: (int i) => setState(() => _tab = i),
  items: const <CairnDockItem>[
    CairnDockItem(icon: CairnIcon(CairnIconData.search), label: 'Search'),
    CairnDockItem(
      icon: CairnIcon(CairnIconData.info),
      label: 'Inbox',
      badge: CairnStatus(tone: CairnTone.destructive),
    ),
    CairnDockItem(
      icon: CairnIcon(CairnIconData.moreHorizontal),
      label: 'More',
    ),
  ],
)
```

## API

### `CairnDockItem`

One destination in a [CairnDock].

**Constructor** `CairnDockItem({required Widget icon, required String label, Widget? badge})`

Creates a dock item.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon` | `Widget` | yes |  | The glyph. Sized to 20px by the dock. |
| `label` | `String` | yes |  | The caption, also used as the accessible name. |
| `badge` | `Widget?` |  |  | An optional [CairnBadge] / [CairnStatus] pinned to the icon. |

### `CairnDock` (widget)

A bottom navigation bar for mobile layouts.

A 64px bar on the `background` surface with a 1px top hairline. Each item is
an icon above a 12px label; the selected item takes `foreground` colour and
semibold weight with a 2px primary bar above it, while the rest stay
`mutedForeground`. Items share the width equally and the whole item is the
tap target, which keeps them above the 48px touch minimum.

Pair with `SafeArea` so the bar clears the home indicator.

```dart
CairnDock(
  index: _tab,
  onChanged: (i) => setState(() => _tab = i),
  items: const [
    CairnDockItem(icon: Icon(Icons.home), label: 'Home'),
    CairnDockItem(icon: Icon(Icons.search), label: 'Search'),
  ],
);
```

**Constructor** `CairnDock({required List<CairnDockItem> items, required int index, required ValueChanged<int> onChanged, double height = 64.0})`

Creates a dock.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | `List<CairnDockItem>` | yes |  | The destinations. |
| `index` | `int` | yes |  | The selected item. |
| `onChanged` | `ValueChanged<int>` | yes |  | Called with the tapped item's index. |
| `height` | `double` |  | `64.0` | The bar height (`h-16`). |

# Link

A text link with muted and underline options.

- Category: Navigation
- Widgets: `CairnLink`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

> Does not navigate. Call your router or url_launcher from onPressed.

## Quick start

```dart
CairnLink(
  onPressed: () => context.go('/docs'),
  child: const Text('Read the docs'),
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Default

```dart
CairnLink(
  onPressed: () {},
  child: const Text('Read the docs'),
)
```

### Muted · underlined

```dart
CairnLink(
  onPressed: () {},
  muted: true,
  underline: true,
  child: const Text('Privacy policy'),
)
```

### Disabled

```dart
const CairnLink(
  onPressed: null,
  child: Text('Disabled'),
)
```

## API

### `CairnLink` (widget)

A text link.

`text-primary font-medium underline-offset-4 hover:underline` — primary
coloured, underlined on hover and on keyboard focus, and drawing the same
3px ring other controls draw when focused so it is findable by keyboard.

Cairn does not navigate: [onPressed] is where you call your router or
`url_launcher`. Set [muted] for the quieter `mutedForeground` variant used
in footers, and [underline] to underline at rest.

```dart
CairnLink(onPressed: () => context.go('/docs'), child: Text('Read the docs'));
```

**Constructor** `CairnLink({required Widget child, required VoidCallback? onPressed, bool muted = false, bool underline = false})`

Creates a link.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `child` | `Widget` | yes |  | The link text. |
| `onPressed` | `VoidCallback?` | yes |  | Called on activation. Null renders it disabled. |
| `muted` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to use the muted colour. |
| `underline` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to underline when not hovered or focused. |

# Radial Progress

An animated progress ring.

- Category: Data & feedback
- Widgets: `CairnRadialProgress`
- Import: `import 'package:cairn_ui/cairn_ui.dart';`

## Quick start

```dart
const CairnRadialProgress(
  value: 0.7,
  tone: CairnTone.success,
  showValue: true,
)
```

## Variants and examples

### Value

```dart
const CairnRadialProgress(value: 0.25, showValue: true)
```

### Success tone

```dart
const CairnRadialProgress(
  value: 0.7,
  tone: CairnTone.success,
  showValue: true,
)
```

### Custom child

```dart
const CairnRadialProgress(
  value: 1,
  size: 80,
  tone: CairnTone.info,
  child: CairnIcon(CairnIconData.check, size: 24),
)
```

## API

### `CairnRadialProgress` (widget)

A circular progress indicator with room for a value in the middle.

The ring analogue of [CairnProgress]: the track is the indicator colour at
20% alpha and the arc is the full colour, so the two halves read as one
object at two strengths. The arc starts at twelve o'clock, runs clockwise,
has round caps, and animates between values at 300ms on the standard curve.

[child] is centred inside the ring; when omitted and [showValue] is true the
percentage is drawn there.

```dart
const CairnRadialProgress(value: 0.7, showValue: true);
```

**Constructor** `CairnRadialProgress({required double value, double size = 64.0, double thickness = 6.0, CairnTone tone = CairnTone.primary, bool showValue = false, Widget? child, String? semanticLabel})`

Creates a radial progress indicator.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `double` | yes |  | Progress from 0 to 1. |
| `size` | `double` |  | `64.0` | The outer diameter. |
| `thickness` | `double` |  | `6.0` | The ring thickness. |
| `tone` | `CairnTone` |  | `CairnTone.primary` | The colour intent. |
| `showValue` | `bool` |  | `false` | Whether to draw the percentage in the centre when [child] is null. |
| `child` | `Widget?` |  |  | Centre content. |
| `semanticLabel` | `String?` |  |  | The accessible name. |
